title: Senior Shopify Developer
description:
We are hiring a contract-based Senior Shopify Developer to contribute to our Design and Development Team.

Original Job posting link here 

🌎 About garden3d 

We are worker owned creative collective, innovating on everything from brands and IRL communities to IoT devices and cross platform apps. We share profit, open source everything, spin out new businesses, and invest in exciting ideas through financial and/or in-kind contributions.

Our client roster includes Google, Stripe, Figma, Hinge, Black Socialists in America, ACLU, Pratt, Parsons, Mozilla, The Nobel Prize, MIT, Gnosis, Etsy & Gagosian.

We’re the software team behind innovative products like The Light Phone & Mill, and we operate a global, decentralized community space collective called Index Space.

We think of our garden3d as collective for creative people, prioritizing a happy, talented, and diverse studio culture. We work on projects that bring value to our world, and we balance deep care for the work we do with a genuine curiosity about life outside of our jobs.

Sanctuary Computer — Development At Sanctuary Computer we’re building a different type of technology shop – one that prioritizes close collaboration between the client and the craftsperson.

Our projects range from design-forward websites, to robust web apps, to native mobile development.

XXIX — Design When we started XXIX in 2013, we set out to create a different kind of design studio and we’ve thrived because we continually ask what a creative practice can be.

We’re building a radically different kind of organization that values autonomy, growth, transparency, and shared responsibility.

Plus, our partner organizations

- Lightphone 

- Mill 

- IngredientAI 

🔮 Who we’re looking for: 

We're looking for a Senior Shopify Developer who balances deep e-commerce expertise with modern frontend engineering. You'll build pixel-perfect, hyper-performant storefronts ranging from custom Liquid themes to headless Hydrogen/Next.js implementations working alongside our design team to create world-class shopping experiences.

In this role, you’ll work across a variety of client projects to find cost-effective, high-quality, and pragmatic solutions to complex e-commerce challenges. Responsibilities will include:

- Collaborating closely with Technical Leads and Designers to meet clients' custom e-commerce and technical needs.

- Building and maintaining high-performance storefronts using both custom Liquid (Online Store 2.0) and modern headless architectures (Shopify Storefront API, GraphQL, Hydrogen/Remix, Next.js).

- Implementing responsive, accessible, and pixel-perfect interfaces based on design specifications, with meticulous attention to product interaction details and motion design.

- Integrating custom storefronts with headless CMS platforms (Sanity, Contentful), payment gateways, subscriptions, search, and third-party e-commerce APIs.

- Optimizing e-commerce performance, focusing heavily on Core Web Vitals, image/video asset delivery, bundle size, and runtime efficiency across high-traffic collection and product pages.

- Architecting scalable, reusable component libraries and design systems tailored for commercial platforms.

- Writing clear documentation for store management, custom app integrations, and codebase maintenance.

- Participating in project team rituals, including Sprint Planning, daily standups, code reviews, and retrospectives.

The person we’re looking for is happy, relaxed and easy to get along with. They’re flexible on anything except conceits that will lower their usually outstanding work quality. They work “smart”, by carefully managing their workflow and staggering features that have dependencies intelligently. They prefer deep work but are OK coming up to the surface now and then for top level / strategic conversations.

We believe people with backgrounds or interests in design, art, music, food or fashion tend to have a well rounded sense of design & quality, so a variety of hobbies or side projects is a big nice to have!

🔑 Must-Have Competencies: 

We’re always pitching for new and exciting technology niches. Some of the areas below are relevant to us!

- 8+ years writing highly performant frontend code with an obsession for 95+ Lighthouse scores and optimal Core Web Vitals.

- Deep Shopify Ecosystem Mastery: Proven experience building custom Shopify themes (Liquid, JSON templates, Online Store 2.0) as well as headless storefronts using the Shopify Storefront API (GraphQL) and frameworks like Hydrogen/Remix or Next.js .

- Modern Frontend Tech: Expert-level experience with TypeScript and modern CSS methodologies (Tailwind CSS, CSS Modules) alongside robust animation libraries (GSAP, Framer Motion).

- Headless CMS & Integrations: Extensive experience merging Shopify with headless CMS platforms like Sanity, Contentful, or Prismic, as well as third-party services (Klaviyo, Recharge, Algolia/Searchspring, Stripe).

- Platform & Hosting: Fluency in industry-standard PaaS platforms including Vercel, Netlify, and Shopify Oxygen.

- Architecture & State Management: Experience with state management solutions (Zustand, Redux, Pinia) and API integration patterns for cart state, multi-currency, and checkout flows.

- Quality & Accessibility: Experience building accessible (WCAG compliant), responsive interfaces with a strong commitment to SEO best practices, testing frameworks (Jest, Playwright, Cypress), and maintainable code.

- Performance Optimization: Practical knowledge of WebSockets, caching strategies (Redis, CDN-level/Cloudflare), and advanced image delivery networks.

💪 Nice-to-Have Competencies: 

- Custom App Development: Building bespoke Shopify Apps using Node.js, Remix, GraphQL Admin API, and Shopify CLI.

- Shopify Plus & Enterprise Features: Hands-on experience with Shopify Functions, Checkout Branding API, Shopify Scripts, and B2B configurations.

- Tracking & Analytics: Setting up server-side tracking, GTM, Meta Pixel, and Customer Privacy APIs without hurting site load times.

- WebGL, Canvas & 3D: Experience building interactive graphics, 3D product visualizers, or canvas animations using Three.js or ``.

- Full-Stack & API Design: Experience across backend/database layers (PostgreSQL), REST/GraphQL API design, and authentication flows (OAuth, JWT).

- Client-Facing & Management: Direct experience working with clients to clarify requirements, defining product roadmaps, or leading engineering teams.

💸 Compensation 

Our pay scale ranges from $40/hr to $120/hr pending seniority (& team leadership experience), and our projects are rarely less than 8 full time weeks at 40 hours per week.

We prefer long standing relationships with highly accountable and communicative team members, so we encourage candidates to expect longer term engagements.

🎤 How we interview 

After you submit your application, a member of our team will reach out. Our interview process starts with an intro call to answer any questions you have about the role and to learn a bit more about your experience and interests.

From there, we’ll follow up with a panel interview call where you get to meet a few members of our team, to openly discuss some of our challenges and ensure your skills and interests align with where we’re going as a business.

For qualified candidates, the process wraps with a reference call, and an offer to follow.

👩‍🏭 How we work: 

We believe that there’s a better balance between the poles of freelancing & full time, and for that reason Sanctuary works differently to most shops:

- Transparency & Ownership : We release out Profit & Loss statements to the community each year, open source our best ideas, and talk business & money with everyone in the company. We’re proud to run our business with integrity, and for that reason we share everything with our team & community.

- 150% Carbon Negative : Our studio offsets 150% of the carbon we use to do business each year, dated back to our founding in 2015. We turn down work that is not in-line with our morals, and we encourage our peers to do the same. We have been certified climate neutral since 2021. 

- Strong Morals: Since our founding, we've turned down somewhere between $1mm - $2mm of work that didn't meet our moral standards. (Most of that was DTC brands that can't show a valid sustainability initiative).

- Async & Decentralized: We use tools optimized for calm, thoughtful communication, and opt for async whenever possible. We fight hard to maintain our focus time.

- Remote Friendly: Our company is fluent in remote work, making our workplace more decentralized, and democratized in the process.

- Ideas & Products: In our spare studio time, we work to build our own open source or internal products to diversify & bolster our income. We create amazing technology products for our clients, so why not for the studio?

→ Read more on our Substack, over here , or our Medium, over there . 

Important Reminders 

Kindly submit a complete and thoughtful application, including relevant links that help verify your work experience and identity. Applications with missing or insufficient information will not move forward in the review process.

Our team carefully reviews every complete submission, and we truly appreciate the time and effort you put into applying! Thank you! :)

title: Senior Software Engineer Full-stack - CDI
description:
Qui sommes-nous ? 

Notre mission 

Avec Solteo, nous voulons donner toutes ses chances à l'électrification des bâtiments en soutenant ceux qui sont en première ligne : les entreprises d’installation. 

⚡ Produire son électricité en solaire, se chauffer avec une pompe à chaleur, recharger son véhicule, stocker : l'électrification des bâtiments est le premier levier de décarbonation . Le photovoltaïque ouvre la marche — selon Xavier Piechaczyk de RTE : “le photovoltaïque a un grand potentiel, mais il faut accélérer rapidement” 

👷‍♂️ La disponibilité des installateurs freine cette accélération. Ces professionnels limités en nombre perdent souvent du temps sur l'organisation et la gestion de projets de plus en plus techniques. Rien qu'en solaire, ils ont 4M de foyers à équiper d'ici 2030 !

💻 Solteo est la plateforme d'organisation de projets d’électrification qui aide les installateurs à gérer leur temps et leurs projets, quel que soit l'équipement posé. Nos premières métriques : 75% de temps gagné, +30% de conversion, et des utilisateurs heureux ! 

Le mot du CTO 

"Quand j’ai rejoint Alexandre et Manon pour créer Solteo, je cherchais un projet qui mettrait mes compétences tech au service de la transition énergétique et où je pourrais voir directement l’impact de mon travail sur le quotidien de nos utilisateurs. Depuis le début, on développe notre produit dans cette optique : avec une attention toute particulière aux feedbacks de nos installateurs. C’est ultra motivant de recevoir leurs retours et de constater concrètement comment on améliore leur quotidien ! En tout cas, si tu veux t’épanouir techniquement, avoir un impact visible et direct sur les utilisateurs de ton produit, et contribuer à un projet porteur de sens, tu as frappé à la bonne porte !" — Kévin 

Et ce poste alors ? 

Le rôle 

Chez Solteo, on veut continuer à accélérer le développement de notre produit sans que chaque sujet complexe repose sur le CTO.

On cherche donc un·e Senior Software Engineer Full-stack capable de prendre en charge des fonctionnalités de bout en bout, depuis la compréhension du besoin jusqu’à leur mise en production.

Tu travailleras en lien direct avec l’équipe produit, les autres développeurs, notre Tech Lead et le CTO. Ton rôle sera de transformer les besoins de nos utilisateurs en fonctionnalités utiles, fiables et simples à maintenir.

Missions et responsabilités 

Tu prendras en charge le développement de fonctionnalités complètes, aussi bien côté frontend que backend.

Concrètement, tu participeras à la compréhension du besoin, au cadrage de la solution, au développement, aux tests, à la mise en production et au suivi de la fonctionnalité une fois livrée.

Tu auras de l’autonomie sur tes sujets, tout en pouvant t’appuyer sur le reste de l’équipe pour échanger, challenger les choix techniques et avancer sur les décisions les plus structurantes.

Ce que tu feras au quotidien 

- Concevoir et développer des fonctionnalités de bout en bout sur l’ensemble de notre stack.

- Travailler avec l’équipe produit pour clarifier les besoins, identifier les cas limites et découper les sujets.

- Écrire du code testé, lisible et maintenable, puis suivre les fonctionnalités après leur mise en production.

- Participer aux revues de code et partager tes connaissances avec le reste de l’équipe.

- Proposer des améliorations pertinentes sur notre code, nos outils et nos pratiques.

Notre stack technique : 

- Frontend web : React

- Backend : Node.js, TypeScript, tRPC

- Base de données : PostgreSQL

- Application mobile : React Native

- Infrastructure: AWS, Docker

- CI/CD : GitHub Actions

- Monitoring : Datadog

Tes objectifs: 

⭐ Après 3 mois 
Avoir livré 2 à 4 évolutions produit , dont au moins une fonctionnalité full-stack de bout en bout.

- Être autonome sur les sujets de complexité intermédiaire, avec un accompagnement ponctuel.

- Contribuer régulièrement aux revues de code et respecter les standards de qualité de l’équipe.

🎯 Objectif : être opérationnel·le sur notre stack et capable de livrer de manière autonome des fonctionnalités de complexité intermédiaire.

⭐ Après 6 mois 
Avoir mené au moins 2 fonctionnalités complexes , de leur cadrage jusqu’à leur suivi en production.

- Être autonome sur les décisions techniques courantes liées à tes sujets.

- Avoir réalisé au moins une amélioration mesurable sur la qualité, la performance ou l’efficacité de l’équipe.

🎯 Objectif : être autonome sur les fonctionnalités complexes et contribuer concrètement à l’amélioration du produit et des pratiques de l’équipe.

⭐ Au-delà d'un an 
Avoir mené 3 à 5 projets produit complexes depuis ton arrivée.

- Être référent·e sur au moins un domaine fonctionnel ou technique du produit.

- Contribuer régulièrement à l’amélioration des pratiques et au partage de connaissances dans l’équipe.

🎯 Objectif : être une personne de confiance pour mener les sujets produit importants et faire progresser durablement l’équipe.

Les compétences qu’on recherche 

- Tu maîtrises TypeScript, React et Node.js .

- Tu as déjà livré des fonctionnalités full-stack sur un produit utilisé en production.

- Tu as une solide expérience avec une base de données relationnelle , idéalement PostgreSQL.

- Tu sais concevoir une fonctionnalité de bout en bout : interface, backend, données, tests et mise en production.

- Tu es autonome pour cadrer, découper et mener des sujets complexes.

Ce qui serait un plus 

- Tu as déjà travaillé avec tRPC .

- Tu as une expérience avec React Native .

- Tu connais AWS, Docker ou GitHub Actions .

- Tu as déjà évolué dans un SaaS B2B ou une petite équipe produit.

- Le secteur de l’énergie et la transition écologique t’intéressent.

Mais Solteo c’est aussi… 

- Un cadre professionnel vivant et énergique, où la prise d’initiatives est non seulement appréciée mais également récompensée.

- La chance de parfaire et d'enrichir tes connaissances dans un secteur en pleine croissance et qui a du sens.

- Des bureaux situés en plein centre de Paris, avec plusieurs autres start-ups du solaire

- Une diversité de projets captivants, offrant l'opportunité de collaborer avec des clients diverses et variés. Pas possible de s’ennuyer !

Nous te promettons aussi une ambiance d’équipe bienveillante, accueillante et stimulante . Et bien sûr, plein d’évènements d’équipe !

Processus de recrutement 

- 📞 Entretien téléphonique (10 min) : pour discuter de ton CV et des attentes sur le poste 

- 🤝 Entretien de fit en visio (45 min) : pour faire connaissance, discuter de ton parcours et de tes motivations avec Kevin (CTO).

- 🎯 Entretien technique (1h30) : avec Kévin (CTO) ou un membre de l’équipe Tech

- 🕵️‍♂️ Prise de références 

- 🍽️ Déjeuner d’équipe : rencontre conviviale avec les fondateurs et toute l'équipe Solteo.

Détails du poste 

- CDI - temps Plein

- Paris 17e

- Prise de poste: dès que possible

- Rémunération : 50-70K€

title: Senior Fullstack AI Engineer (w/m/d)
description:
Jobbeschreibung 

StackFuel ist seit Jahren einer der führenden Anbieter für Daten- und KI-Weiterbildung in Deutschland. Seit Anfang 2026 sind wir Teil von Multiverse, Europas einzigem EdTech-Unicorn und der größten AI-Upskilling-Plattform des Kontinents. Gemeinsam verfolgen wir ein klares Ziel: 100.000 Beschäftigte in Deutschland fit für KI zu machen und so die Daten- und KI-Kompetenzlücke im Land zu schließen.

Damit das gelingt, bauen wir von Berlin aus eine adaptive Lernplattform der nächsten Generation, AI-first von Grund auf. Daneben entwickeln wir Software-Tools und Automatisierungen, die sich in die B2B-Plattformen unserer Kunden integrieren. Als Senior Fullstack AI Engineer (m/w/d) gestaltest du diese Plattform und Software-Tools maßgeblich mit, von der Datenbank bis zum Frontend. Deine Arbeit erreicht direkt Tausende Lernende und trägt zur Transformation im Mittelstand und großen deutschen Unternehmen bei.

Deine Aufgaben 

- Du entwickelst unsere adaptive AI-first Lernplattform sowie software-gestützte KI-Lösungen End-to-End und triffst dabei selbständig wichtige technische Architekturentscheidungen

- Du setzt neue Features und Anforderungen in unserem bestehenden Learning Framework um und hältst Neu- und Weiterentwicklung in Balance

- Du baust AI-Features in die Plattform ein, z. B. LLM-gestützte Lernbegleitung, adaptive Lernpfade oder automatisierte Content-Generierung, und sorgst dafür, dass sie zuverlässig, messbar und kosteneffizient laufen

- Du baust interne Tools und KI-Automatisierungen für Learning Coaches, Client Operations und Sales, damit diese Teams effizienter arbeiten

- Du arbeitest eng mit dem gesamten Engineering-Team, unserem Content Engineering und den Portfolio Leads zusammen

Was du mitbringst 

- 5+ Jahre Erfahrung in der Full-Stack-Entwicklung, davon mehrere in Senior-Verantwortung (Architektur, technische Entscheidungen, Mentoring)

- Du arbeitest AI-first und nutzt AI-Tools selbstverständlich im Engineering-Alltag, der Agentic SDLC ist kein Fremdwort, sondern ein Zielbild

- Praktische Erfahrung mit LLM-APIs in Produkten: Prompt-Design, Structured Outputs, Tool Use, Evaluation von Modellausgaben

- Erfahrung mit End-to-End-Entwicklung mit Python (FastAPI oder Django) und TypeScript/React

- Sicherer Umgang mit PostgreSQL und Schema-Migrationen

- Disziplin bei Testing und CI (z. B. Pytest, typisierter Code, GitHub Actions o. Ä.)

- Erfahrung mit Docker-basiertem Deployment und Grundlagen in Observability

- Du sprichst verhandlungssicheres Englisch und idealerweise Deutsch auf B1–B2-Niveau

Passt eher nicht zu dir, wenn … 

Diese Rolle ist wahrscheinlich nicht das Richtige für dich, wenn du nur auf der grünen Wiese arbeiten möchtest. Neben dem Aufbau unserer neuen Plattform entwickelst du auch unser bestehendes Learning Framework weiter, und beides gehört gleichwertig dazu. Und wenn dich interne Tools weniger reizen als das große Produkt, wirst du hier eher nicht glücklich: Das Backoffice für Learning Coaches, Client Operations und Sales ist ein zentraler Teil der Rolle, und gerade dort spürst du deinen Impact oft am schnellsten.

Das bieten wir Dir 

Arbeitskultur 

Dich erwartet eine lösungsorientierte und datengetriebene Arbeitsweise, eine offene Feedbackkultur sowie ein starker Teamspirit. Zwei vom gesamten StackFuel-Team gewählte Trustees unterstützen Dich bei Fragen und Anliegen als neutrale, vertrauliche Anlaufstelle.

Ownership 

Übernehme ab dem ersten Tag Verantwortung, bringe Deine eigenen Ideen aktiv ein, gestalte Prozesse nachhaltig und präge unsere Abläufe maßgeblich mit.

Wir arbeiten in einem hybriden Modell und sind üblicherweise 3 Tage pro Woche vor Ort in unserem Office in Berlin.

Workation 

Bis zu 10 Tage pro Jahr kannst Du von überall aus der EU, dem EWR und der Türkei arbeiten.

Raum für Austausch 

Regelmäßiger Austausch im Team, saisonale Feiern und eine immer gut gefüllte Küche sorgen für ein lebendiges Miteinander.

Weiterentwicklung 

Absolviere unsere Online-Trainings, um Deine fachlichen Fähigkeiten auszubauen und Dich zur Expert:in für Daten und KI zu entwickeln.

About the Role 

As a Senior Backend Engineer, you'll join a spectacularly talented team of fellow engineers—but you will also be expected to independently own your product workflow from initial design requirements through deployment. You will be expected to move aggressively, and you will commit code daily, but you'll get that rush of seeing your work in the wild with live users on a regular basis as you build a revolutionary product from scratch.

You are an experienced engineer who can identify problems and architect the highest-quality solutions. You are curious and enjoy working on ambiguous problems where the solutions are not (yet) well-defined. You take pride in your craft, have impeccable communication skills, and you absorb feedback exceptionally well. You aren't afraid to make mistakes and learn from them. Above all, you enjoy taking ownership and are stifled by large organizations.

What You'll Do 

- 
Design and build scalable services and APIs to drive existing and new features for web applications.

- 
Architect and maintain robust backend systems, database models, and infrastructure that power our platform.

- 
Analyze product requirements and produce high-quality, production-ready code with a focus on system reliability and performance.

- 
Maintain the health of our systems and codebase, refactor and make improvements, and keep our systems robust and resilient.

- 
Jump into frontend code when needed to support the team and ship features end-to-end.

- 
Be autonomous. You'll take full ownership of your work, and you take responsibility and accountability for every last detail, every step of the way.

- 
Be a collaborator. You'll work with other engineers and cross-functional partners in product and design to build a world-class product and lead new initiatives to improve our user experience.

- 
Write clear specs to ensure product/code quality for stress-free deployment.

- 
Drive large releases to production on a continuous deployment cadence.

What You Bring to the Table 

- 
Experience working in a start-up environment.

- 
5+ years of relevant experience in backend development with some frontend exposure.

- 
Strong fundamentals in API design, database architecture, and distributed systems.

- 
Expertise in Typescript/Node and backend frameworks.

- 
Comfort with React and frontend technologies—you can jump in and contribute when needed, even if it's not your primary focus.

- 
An intuitive understanding of what it takes to create performant, scalable systems that power delightful user experiences.

- 
Strong communication skills that help you influence product direction and help collaborative visions come to life.

- 
Extreme bias toward action and execution. You get antsy if you're not writing code, improving the codebase, and vigilantly enhancing the systems that represent the big-thinking work.

Our Tech Stack 

- 
Typescript across all our applications

- 
NestJS API with TypeORM

- 
Postgres

- 
Redis

- 
GCP

- 
React (for when you need to dabble on the frontend)

- 
Custom UI library built on shadcn

- 
Tailwind

Applicants must be based in the United States. 

Up for the Challenge? 

We look forward to meeting you.

title: Senior Full Stack
description:
Headquarters: Tallinn, Estonia

URL: https://toggl.com/jobs/ 

We are looking for a Senior Full Stack Engineer to join one of our Product Tribes, the cross-functional units that own the end-to-end experience for a specific Toggl user role. You'll join the Tribe building for managers, the people who plan work, protect margins, and keep projects on time and on budget.

You own significant parts of that experience end-to-end, working hands-on with product and design to ship work that matters. You'll do this as we build and launch Toggl 2.0, our consolidated planning, time tracking, and time intelligence product.

The salary for this position is €83,000 annually. 

You can work from anywhere in the world as long as your main location is between UTC-4 and UTC+4. 

The Role 

As a Senior Full Stack Engineer, you own meaningful parts of the product end-to-end, from the data model and the API to the interface someone actually clicks: the technical approach, the quality of what ships, and whether it actually works for the people using it. You are accountable not for tickets closed, but for clarity, craft, and outcomes.

You'll work in the Tribe serving managers, across planning and capacity management, dashboards, and billable work. This is some of the most data-dense, interaction-heavy surface area in the product: schedules and capacity views, reports, and visualizations that have to stay fast and readable at real customer scale. The interesting problems live on both sides of the API here - the query behind a capacity view matters as much as how that view renders. You'll build with React and TypeScript on the frontend and our backend services (mostly Golang) and data layer (Postgres) behind them, alongside a product manager, a designer, and engineers who are used to owning their work and pushing back when something isn't right. In a tribe of 5 other engineers, your impact and visibility are high.

Our team meetings are scheduled between 11:00 and 16:00 UTC. Your availability and commitment to participate in these sessions are essential for effective collaboration and team alignment.

Your main responsibilities will be:

Ownership and delivery 

- 
Take projects from problem to production. Own the technical approach for major features front to back, break the work down sensibly, sequence it, and ship in slices rather than one big drop.

- 
Make the technical calls in your area. Choose between options, name the tradeoffs, and decide without waiting for permission or escalating routine judgment.

- 
Keep your work visible without being chased. Flag risks and slips early, keep the Tribe in the loop, and unblock yourself.

Craft and quality across the stack 

- 
Build interfaces people trust with dense, real-world data. Planning views, dashboards, and reports that stay fast, accessible, and readable when the dataset gets ugly.

- 
Design the data and API layer those views depend on. Model it so the feature you're building now doesn't make the next three harder.

- 
Own performance as a feature, end to end. Profile, measure, and fix the slow query and the slow render instead of hoping the data stays small.

- 
Write code others can work in. Sensible components and services, real test coverage where it earns its keep, and a codebase that's easier to change after you touch it.

Working with product and design 

- 
Shape solutions, don't just implement them. Push on the problem, question requirements that don't hold up, and propose simpler paths when you see one.

- 
Partner closely with design. Prototype early, spot the edge cases in a flow before it's built, and hold the bar on UX quality with your designer rather than after handoff.

- 
Stay close to users and evidence. Join user tests, read the feedback, look at the data, and let it change what you build.

Raising the bar 

- 
Review code with intent. Give precise, actionable feedback that makes the change and the person better.

- 
Mentor and interview. Help other engineers grow, and help us hire well.

- 
Improve things across team boundaries. Spot shared components and duplicated work between Tribes, and raise it before we build the same thing twice.

AI as core leverage 

- 
Use AI tools extensively in your daily work for exploration, prototyping, code generation and review, debugging, research, and writing. AI fluency is not optional. It's part of how you increase your speed, depth, and impact - and you're expected to help the rest of the Tribe get better at it too.

About You 

You will thrive in this role if you:

- 
Have significant experience building and shipping production web applications end to end, and can lead major projects rather than just contribute to them.

- 
Are genuinely comfortable on both sides of the stack. You're deep on one side and properly capable on the other, not someone who hands off at the API boundary.

- 
Have deep, practical knowledge of JavaScript, TypeScript, React, and modern CSS - including state management and side-effect handling in large applications.

- 
Are solid on backend fundamentals: at least one backend language you know well, API design, relational data modelling, and enough instinct for query performance to spot the problem before production does. Prior Golang experience is not mandatory but you have to be willing to adopt it and become comfortable with it fast. 

- 
Hold an extremely high bar for quality. You know what great looks like, you notice the details others miss, and you don't ship work you wouldn't put your name on.

- 
Have a knack for data-heavy product surfaces - performance, readability, and the principles behind a chart that actually communicates something.

- 
Care about the user's problem, not just the ticket. You start from what someone is trying to get done and work back to the implementation.

- 
Own outcomes, not output. You follow your work into production, watch how it behaves, and fix what needs fixing.

- 
Thrive in ambiguity and move fast. You make confident decisions with incomplete information, adapt when things change, and course-correct without drama.

- 
Are hands-on with AI tools. You actively use AI as a core part of how you build, not a side experiment, and you have opinions about where it helps and where it doesn't.

- 
Don't need to be managed. You set your own direction, keep people in the loop, and ask for help when it matters.

- 
Have excellent written and verbal English communication skills. You write clearly, explain technical tradeoffs to non-engineers without jargon, and default to async communication that others can follow.

- 
Are eager to contribute to the engineering team's growth - code review, mentoring, and interviewing included.

- 
Value transparency, ownership, and speed over perfection. You ship, learn, and improve rather than waiting for the perfect plan.

- 
Nice to have: 

- 
Experience with TanStack is a bonus, and so is a real understanding of frontend caching and eventual consistency, we'd love to hire someone who's dealt with that tradeoff directly.

- 
Experience with capacity planning, scheduling, reporting, or other complex B2B SaaS products.

- 
Experience working with distributed or microservice systems, a basic understanding of infrastructure and infrastructure as code, and some experience creating, improving, or debugging CI/CD pipelines.

This Role Is NOT 

- 
A ticket-taker role. If you want fully specced work handed to you, this isn't the right fit.

- 
A pixel-pusher translating finished designs into code with no say in the problem or the solution.

- 
A role where you hand off at the API boundary. If "that's a backend ticket" is your instinct, this will frustrate you.

- 
A role where quality is someone else's job. Toggl doesn't have a dedicated QA
team or layer: there's no separate team that will catch your bugs, write your
tests, or own your performance regressions.

- 
A place to work in isolation from users. You'll be expected to know who you're building for and why.

- 
A role for people who need heavy process, frequent approvals, or top-down direction to do their best work.

The Team 

We are a global team of ~80 awesome people working from over 40 countries around the globe. We hire globally, you work locally—in the heart of London, a beach outside of Río de Janeiro, or a quiet village near Florence, the choice is yours. Every few months we travel to meet up somewhere in the world and spend some quality time together. We place a huge amount of trust in our people, and we measure the outcomes rather than the work itself. Our values fuel our results.

What's Happening at Toggl 

Toggl is at an exciting turning point. We're taking our best-in-class time tracking - trusted and loved by millions of users worldwide - and expanding it into something bigger: Toggl 2.0 . One product that brings together time tracking, planning, capacity management, reporting, and insight. The idea is simple: better time tracking creates better data, which powers everything else. We call it time intelligence. We build with AI throughout, and we think it's a real multiplier for strong engineers rather than a substitute for them. The judgment, the tradeoffs, and the accountability for what ships stay with people.

Benefits 

- 
Freedom to choose when and how much you work—we only measure results

- 
24 days of paid time off a year, plus your local holidays

- 
Unlimited sick leave

- 
In-person meetups for team-building (expenses covered)

- 
4-6 weeks paid sabbatical (depending on tenure)

- 
Laptop budget up to 2,500€ and it renews every 3 years

- 
€2,000 budget to set up your home office and an additional €300 every year after 3 years of tenure

- 
€3,000 per year for co-working space membership and/or internet service at home

- 
€4,000 per year contribution to use for training, workshops, and conferences

- 
€2,400 per year contribution for any equipment or services to improve and/or maintain your physical and mental health

- 
Support for buying tools you need for doing your best work (even eyeglasses if you need a new pair)

To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/toggl-senior-full-stack

title: Senior Software Engineer, Agentic Customer Platform (Poland, Remote, B2B)
description:
Who we are 

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role: 

We're building the next chapter: an agentic platform that understands operational context and takes action, with the ambition to make physical operations increasingly autonomous. External Platform EMEA owns critical capabilities behind that transition. Depending on the team, your work could include:

- Reporting and intelligence. Own the reporting engine and products that turn the complexity of a fleet into answers customers can act on.

- Enterprise administration. Build how customers configure and control Samsara at scale, from permissions and device metadata to AI-assisted onboarding.

- Developer and agent platform. Build APIs, event systems, integrations, and tools that give applications and AI agents access to operational data and actions.

- Business-critical infrastructure. Own billing, license assignment, and usage metering: systems central to how Samsara sells, delivers, and grows its products.

The long-term opportunity is rooted in the physical world. Deployed hardware, data generated at the edge, and years of operational expertise form a foundation that's hard to replicate. As AI advances, it expands what we can build on that foundation. This is a place to develop deep engineering expertise while helping shape a platform with years of ambitious work ahead.

AI is also central to how we build. We expect engineers to push tools like Codex, Claude Code, and Cursor throughout design, implementation, testing, and production investigations, taking on more ambitious work while owning the quality of what they ship.

This is a remote position open to candidates residing in Poland.

In this role, you will: 

- Build foundational capabilities for Samsara’s agentic experiences, enabling AI agents to securely discover data, use tools, integrate with external systems, and execute reliable workflows at enterprise scale.

- Design systems for high throughput, availability, observability, security, and maintainability.

- Apply AI assistants, including Codex, Claude Code, and Cursor - across design, implementation, testing, debugging, and code review.

- Improve frameworks, tooling, and engineering practices that increase the effectiveness of teams across Samsara.

- Mentor other engineers and contribute to architectural decisions and technical strategy.

- Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices

- Hire, develop and lead an inclusive, engaged, and high performing team 

Minimum requirements for the role: 

- 4+ years of relevant engineering experience , with a track record of shipping and improving production software.

- Proven end-to-end ownership of a product, substantial feature, or subsystem through design, implementation, launch, and iteration.

- Ability to take a clear customer or business challenge, independently choose a technical approach, and balance delivery speed, quality, and maintainability.

- Experience driving delivery with engineers and product or design partners, and helping teammates improve through reviews, technical feedback, or mentoring.

- Extensive practical use of AI across investigation, design, implementation, testing, and review, while owning the correctness and quality of the result.

An ideal candidate also has: 

- Designing and operating public-facing REST or GraphQL APIs.

- High-throughput event-streaming platform.

- Building extensible integration or application frameworks.

- Distributed data-fetching, query execution, reporting, or analytical systems.

- Experience in any one of these areas is a plus. Exposure should come from production work.

- Reporting and data systems: Reporting products, analytics, query execution, data retrieval, or turning complex datasets into useful customer experiences.

- Enterprise administration: Permissions and access control, entity metadata, configuration frameworks, or customer onboarding and setup automation.

- Developer and agent platforms: Public APIs, event-driven systems, integrations, Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers, or tools that let AI agents access data and take action.

- Billing and monetization: Billing systems, license assignment, product entitlements, or usage metering supporting how a business sells and delivers its products.

- Full-stack product development: Building complete customer experiences across frontend interfaces, backend services, and data models.

Total Rewards 

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working 

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara 

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations 

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email accessibleinterviewing@samsara.com or click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity 

We use Tofu , a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara’s Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers 

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in @samsara.com, @us-greenhouse-mail.io or @mail3.guide.co. For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here .

title: Senior Angular Developer
Senior Frontend Engineer
description:
About Heidi Systems

Heidi Systems builds the energy OS for real estate. We help property managers and owners get their heating, water and electricity meters online, see consumption in real time and run the yearly utility billing without paper, Excel and site visits.

Submetering in Germany is still mostly analog. Meters get read by hand, data sits in PDFs, and tenants see their consumption once a year. We change that end to end: we install the meters and gateways in the building, collect the data and build the web platform property managers work in.

We're a small team in Berlin. Product and engineering work directly with the founders, and what you ship lands with real customers fast.

The role

We're looking for a best-in-class frontend engineer. Someone whose code other engineers learn from.

You'll be our senior frontend engineer and own the web platform end to end: architecture, code quality and the day-to-day experience of the property managers using it.

The platform is a SvelteKit and TypeScript app. It shows consumption data per building and unit, flags anomalies, manages tenants and owners, and produces the documents for the yearly billing. A lot of it is data-heavy UI, and it has to be right, because the numbers end up on invoices.

You'll work closely with our backend engineers and the founders, and you'll help onboard and mentor junior developers and interns as the team grows.

What you'll do

- Own the frontend architecture of our SvelteKit app: routing, load functions, SSR, state and how we talk to the backend via oRPC

- Ship features end to end, from a rough idea with the founders to production, often before the design is final

- Build the data-heavy parts of the product: consumption dashboards, notification rules, tenant and owner management, billing documents

- Set up and maintain our component library on Tailwind and DaisyUI so the UI stays consistent as we add features

- Raise the bar on quality: strict TypeScript, Vitest coverage, code reviews, a sane PR flow

- Shape the API contract together with backend (types, Zod schemas, error handling) so frontend and backend stay in sync

- Mentor juniors and interns through reviews and pairing

What you bring

- 5+ years of professional frontend experience, ideally at startups or other fast-moving product teams

- 2+ years building production apps with Svelte and SvelteKit, with a deep understanding of its reactivity model, stores, lifecycle, routing, load functions and SSR

- Strong TypeScript: strict mode, generics, utility types, and the judgment to know when types help and when they get in the way

- Hands-on with Tailwind CSS (DaisyUI is a plus)

- Experience with RPC-style APIs (oRPC, tRPC or similar) and typed contracts between frontend and backend

- Testing as a habit: Vitest, JSDom or comparable tooling

- Comfortable in a Unix environment (Linux or macOS), with Git, branches and PRs

- You've made architecture decisions on a real product and can explain the trade-offs

- You work well with little oversight and ship in small, frequent steps

- Fluent English, written and spoken

- You're in Berlin or willing to move, and you're in our office 2 to 3 days a week

How we work

- Hybrid in Berlin. You're in the office 2 to 3 days a week. That's fixed. The rest of the week you work from wherever you like.

- Short paths. You talk to the founders directly, most decisions take one call.

- Real ownership. The frontend is yours to shape, and you'll set many of the standards the team builds on.

- Real impact. Your work runs in buildings across Germany and makes energy use visible where people live.

- Room to grow with the company as the engineering team gets bigger.

Your next steps

title: Product Owner (m/w/d) | Festanstellung oder Freelance | München / Remote
description:
Standort: München, remote innerhalb Deutschlands

Art: Festanstellung in Vollzeit oder freiberufliche Zusammenarbeit, jeweils mit Perspektive auf eine langfristige Partnerschaft

Warum diese Rolle 

Wir bauen Software, mit der echte Unternehmen arbeiten. Du wirst Teil eines kleinen, erfahrenen und schnellen Teams, in dem du als Product Owner die Produktvision und die Umsetzung von Anfang bis Ende verantwortest, statt ein Backlog abzuarbeiten, das jemand anderes vorgekaut hat. Du arbeitest eng mit erfahrenen Engineers zusammen, steuerst KI-gestützte Entwicklungsabläufe und bringst Features innerhalb weniger Wochen vom Konzept in die Produktion.

Diese Rolle ist für jemanden, der in Systemen, Nutzen für die Anwender und operativer Klarheit denkt, nicht nur in Jira-Status.

Ehrlich gesagt: KI im Jahr 2026 

Wir entwickeln schnell mit modernen KI-Werkzeugen (Cursor, Claude, Copilot usw.). Als unser Product Owner musst du selbst keinen Produktivcode schreiben, aber du musst verstehen, wie KI-native Entwicklung Lieferzyklen, Aufwandsschätzung und Scoping verändert.

Die KI-Werkzeuge können Code schreiben, aber sie wissen nicht, was unsere Kunden wirklich brauchen, wie Abläufe über Unternehmen hinweg zusammenhängen oder welche Kompromisse für unsere Architektur sinnvoll sind. Genau für dieses Urteilsvermögen suchen wir dich. Die Messlatte ist nicht „Kannst du eine User-Story-Vorlage ausfüllen?“. Die Messlatte ist: Kannst du eine unübersichtliche betriebliche Realität in glasklare Produktanforderungen übersetzen, konsequent priorisieren und Entwickler wie KI-Assistenten effizient dahin lenken, das Richtige zu bauen?

Aufgaben

Was du machst 

- Du verantwortest Roadmap und Backlog: Du definierst, schneidest und priorisierst Features vom Konzept bis zur Produktion.

- Du übersetzt übergeordnete Geschäftsziele in präzise, umsetzbare Anforderungen und Datenmodelle, mit denen unser Engineering-Team und unsere KI-Werkzeuge arbeiten können.

- Du sorgst für reibungslose Kommunikation zwischen Stakeholdern, Entwicklern und Anwendern, auf Deutsch und Englisch.

- Du steuerst Sprints, räumst Hindernisse aus dem Weg und hältst das Tempo hoch, ohne unnötige Bürokratie.

- Du prüfst ausgelieferte Features gegen die Akzeptanzkriterien und achtest auf hohe Qualität, gute UX und echten geschäftlichen Nutzen.

- Du entwickelst unsere Produktprozesse mit unserem Wachstum weiter, hältst Feedbackschleifen kurz und die Developer Experience reibungslos.

Unser Stack und unsere Arbeitsweise 

- Methodik: agil, Lean Product Development, kurze Iterationen, wenig Bürokratie

- Technologie: TypeScript, Python, React, Next.js, Supabase, Postgres, Cloudflare

- KI-native Werkzeuge: Cursor, Copilot und Claude Code als fester Bestandteil unserer Entwicklung

- Kommunikation: verhandlungssicheres Deutsch und Englisch

Du musst nicht programmieren, aber du sprichst fließend „Tech“ und verstehst, wie moderne Software unter der Haube gebaut wird.

Anforderungen

Was wir suchen 

Must-haves 

- Nachweisbare Erfahrung als Product Owner, Technical Project Manager oder Product Lead in der Softwareentwicklung.

- Fließendes Deutsch (mindestens C1) in Wort und Schrift sowie sehr gutes Englisch (mindestens C1), unverzichtbar für die Abstimmung mit Kunden, Stakeholdern und dem Team.

- Ausgeprägtes technisches Verständnis: Du kennst moderne Web-Stacks, Datenbanken (Postgres) und APIs und weißt, wie Softwarearchitektur funktioniert.

- Vertrautheit mit KI-gestützter Softwareentwicklung und ihren Auswirkungen auf Produktplanung und Tempo.

- Leidenschaft für Klarheit: Du schreibst knappe Spezifikationen, Edge Cases und Akzeptanzkriterien, die keine Fragen offenlassen.

- Selbstständige, pragmatische und proaktive Arbeitsweise.

Nice-to-haves 

- Hintergrund in Softwareentwicklung oder Informatik.

- Erfahrung in Start-ups oder in schnellen, erfahrenen Produktteams.

- Praxis mit modernen Kollaborations- und Projektwerkzeugen (Linear, Notion, GitHub Projects).

Uns sind dein Urteilsvermögen beim Strukturieren und dein Umsetzungstempo deutlich wichtiger als die Länge deines Lebenslaufs.

Benefits

So arbeiten wir 

- Kleines, erfahrenes Team: direkte Zusammenarbeit mit erfahrenen Gründern und Engineers. Deine Entscheidungen zählen vom ersten Tag an.

- Flexibel: remote innerhalb Deutschlands, Standort München. Wichtig ist uns verlässliche Erreichbarkeit zu den üblichen Geschäftszeiten.

- Wenig Bürokratie: klare Verantwortlichkeiten, schnelles Feedback, keine endlosen Abstimmungsrunden.

Was wir bieten 

- Festanstellung in Vollzeit oder freiberufliche Zusammenarbeit, je nachdem, was besser zu dir passt.

- Eine Vergütung, die deiner Erfahrung entspricht, als Gehalt oder als Tages- bzw. Stundensatz.

- Die langfristige Perspektive, unseren Produktkern zu verantworten.

- Viel Eigenverantwortung und unmittelbare Wirkung auf ein echtes Produkt, das von aktiven Unternehmen genutzt wird.

So bewirbst du dich 

Schick uns eine kurze Nachricht über dich, deinen Hintergrund und deine Verfügbarkeit, dazu deine Gehaltsvorstellung oder deinen Tagessatz sowie dein LinkedIn-Profil oder Portfolio. Erzähl uns von einem komplexen Produkt oder Projekt, das du erfolgreich vom Chaos zur Klarheit geführt hast.

Kein Aufsatz nötig. Wir sehen uns jede Bewerbung an und antworten allen.

title: Frontend Engineer - Agentic AI
description:
About Us 

Hawk is the leading provider of AI-supported anti-money laundering and fraud detection technology. Banks and payment providers globally are using Hawk’s powerful combination of traditional rules and explainable AI to improve the effectiveness of their AML compliance and fraud prevention by identifying more crime while maximizing efficiency by reducing false positives. With our solution, we are playing a vital role in the global fight against Money Laundering, Fraud, or the financing of terrorism. We offer a culture of mutual trust, support and passion – while providing individuals with opportunities to grow professionally and make a difference in the world. 

Your Mission 

As a Frontend Engineer at Hawk, you will build and maintain the user interface of our agentic AI Investigation Agent. This is the product where compliance analysts configure AI workflows, watch autonomous investigations run, and review, question and act on what the agent concludes.

The frontend is a modern TypeScript monorepo made of a host application and a growing set of independently deployable microfrontends. These remotes are designed to be built once and used in two places: our new shadcn/ui-based Investigation Agent and our existing Material UI-based Case Manager. Your job is to understand this codebase deeply, keep it healthy, and ship new features with care, from the component level all the way to how it is built and deployed.

What You'll Work On: 

- Features: Build product features end to end in React and TypeScript, such as workflow graph editors, investigation timelines, data-heavy tables and dashboards that make agentic AI output understandable for analysts.

- Microfrontends: Develop and maintain Module Federation remotes, keep remote/host contracts stable, and make sure features fit into both the Investigation Agent and the MUI-based Case Manager.

- Design system and data layer: Contribute to our shared shadcn/ui + Tailwind component library (documented in Storybook), and consume our Python/FastAPI backends through OpenAPI-generated clients with TanStack Query and Router.

- Build, test and deploy: Work in a pnpm + Turborepo monorepo with GitHub Actions CI, Vitest and Playwright tests, and deployments to AWS including per-PR preview environments.

- Collaboration: Work closely with Product, UX, backend engineers and Data Science, and use AI coding tools such as Claude Code or Cursor as part of your everyday workflow.

Your Profile: 

- 3–5 years building and maintaining production React applications, with strong TypeScript and modern React skills (hooks, composition, performance, complex state and forms).

- Clean frontend architecture: you structure code around features and clear boundaries. You keep UI components presentational and reusable, put data fetching and business logic in hooks and typed API layers, and keep server state separate from local UI state. You prefer composition, small focused components and strict typing, and you treat cross-module contracts as an API.

- Design-system experience: hands-on work with a component-library approach, ideally shadcn/ui, Radix and Tailwind. Familiarity with Material UI is a strong plus.

- Microfrontends and delivery: Module Federation or similar runtime composition, shared dependencies and host/remote contracts, plus the build and deployment basics behind them: Vite, monorepos (pnpm workspaces, Turborepo or Nx), CI pipelines (GitHub Actions)

- Comfort with ambiguity : you're happy working on problems that aren't fully defined yet. You ask the right questions, make sensible assumptions, build a first version and refine it with Product and UX, without waiting for a perfect spec.

- AI tooling: daily, practical use of AI coding assistants (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, etc.).

- Communication: clear communication in English, and the ability to explain technical decisions to both technical and non-technical colleagues.

Bonus: 

- Some Python: enough to read a FastAPI endpoint or Pydantic model, run the backend locally, trace a bug across the API boundary, or open a small backend PR. You don't need to be a backend engineer.

- Infrastructure as code: exposure to Terraform or AWS CDK.

- Quality tooling: Storybook-driven development, visual regression testing or accessibility testing.

- Auth: Auth0/OIDC integration in single-page apps.

- Domain interest: UX for AI products, or previous work in fintech, RegTech or compliance.

title: Mid/Sr. Product Engineer, Intelligence
description:
Who we are 

Help Scout started in 2011 with a simple premise: support software should treat customers like people, not tickets. 3+ billion conversations later, more than 10,000 companies use Help Scout to grow relationships with customers of all types, from clients to patients and beyond.

Now we’re in a new chapter: not only building AI that gives teams more space to focus on the customer experience, but also reimagining how we operate in an AI-native world. That means shipping and learning faster, without compromising on craft. Great work here carries a strong opinion and sweats the details, regardless of the tools we use to drive it.

We’ve been a fully remote team since day one, with 120+ teammates now all over the world. It’s a culture where you’ll be trusted to take ownership, stay curious, and raise the quality of work around you. It comes with clear expectations and a team that will push you to do some of the best work of your career.

If that kind of challenge gives you energy, we’d love to meet you.

About this role 

This role sits on our Intelligence team — the group building cross-platform experiences that surface actionable data to customers exactly when and where they're most helpful.

We're looking for an engineer who can build that end-to-end. You'll have a frontend focus (strong JavaScript/TypeScript and real front-end craft) while operating as a full-stack product engineer.

How we work 

Engineers at Help Scout own their work end-to-end — from problem definition through production, and from the customer signal that shaped the bet to the dashboard that tells you whether it landed. You're full-stack capable, customer-fluent, and genuinely fast with AI tools.

- 
We develop in TypeScript, React , Kotlin, Java, and PHP.

- 
We leverage Elasticsearch, ClickHouse, Kafka, Flink, RabbitMQ, MySQL, and PostgreSQL — plus vector search and LLM tooling for our AI features.

- 
We're heavy users of the AWS ecosystem, Slack, GitHub, and Linear.

- 
We use AI tools — Cursor, Claude Code, and a growing set of internal tools — every day. We treat our AI workflow as a product we're shaping together, and we expect you to help shape it.

- 
Teams are small and project-based. You might be 3 engineers and a PM on one project, 2 engineers and a designer on the next, or holding more of the product thinking yourself. You're expected to operate well across different compositions and ship end-to-end.

What you'll do 

- 
Ship customer facing features across the full stack, with a focus on smooth user experiences. You’ll design and build intelligence features from zero-to-one from loosely defined specs, collaborating closely with your product, design, and engineering teammates. You should be comfortable making calls, evaluating outcomes, and iterating on your work to make the best experience for customers.

- 
Sweat the front-end craft. You care about responsiveness, streaming/loading states, accessibility, and the small details that make an assistive feature feel reliable rather than gimmicky.

- 
Stay close to customers. Join customer calls when more context is needed to design the right solution, participate in a support escalation rotation, and watch session recordings on the features you own. Bring that signal back into the work.

- 
Own outcomes, not just output. Before a project starts, you and a PM agree on a specific outcome metric the work is trying to move. You instrument it, and after it ships you're watching the dashboard and talking to customers to ensure its impact.

- 
Co-author the solution. PMs own strategy and sequencing; you bring the judgment and craft for how solutions actually get built. You'll often shape the product thinking too. The best work happens when engineers, designers, and PMs support each other.

- 
Own production readiness from the start. Automation, reliability, monitoring, alerting, and logging are all part of how you ship. The work continues after merge.

- 
Use AI tools every day as part of your craft. We expect fluency with Cursor, Claude Code, or similar. If you saw a way to make the team's AI workflow better tomorrow, you'd say so.

- 
Help us hire. From time to time, partner with our Talent team to interview future teammates. This is one of the highest-leverage things any engineer here does.

About you 

- 
You're a strong, full-stack-capable engineer. You have substantial JavaScript/TypeScript and React experience and real front-end craft, and you take initiative across the stack and ship end-to-end without waiting for someone to own the other half.

- 
You hold a high bar for AI quality. You think in terms of evaluation, verification, and guardrails; you measure whether an AI feature works rather than assuming it does; and you know that more AI-generated code is not the same as more value.

- 
You're genuinely fluent with AI coding tools and treat them as part of your craft. You move fast without sacrificing judgment, and you have a point of view on where these tools are heading.

- 
You're customer-fluent. You actively seek out customer signal because it's how you stay connected to whether your work is actually solving the problem.

- 
You own outcomes. You measure your work, and you're comfortable saying "this didn't move what we hoped, here's what we want to try next," then following through.

- 
You take ownership of the full development lifecycle — automation, reliability, resilience, monitoring, alerting, and logging built in from the start. You stay with what you ship until the metric moves and the customer is better off.

- 
You communicate clearly in writing and in conversation. Help Scout is fully remote and writing is the medium of most decisions. You give and receive direct feedback, and you see code review and pairing as real chances to teach and learn.

Nice to have 

- 
Experience making LLM features production-grade: latency/cost tuning, fallbacks and circuit breakers across providers, moderation/safety, and handling sensitive data responsibly.

- 
Design sensibility — comfort partnering closely with designers and elevating the craft of an interface, not just implementing a spec.

- 
Experience in customer support, productivity, or other tools where trust and reliability are the product.

Company values

Happy to Help 

Help is in our first name! We show up for each other — not out of obligation, but because we’re invested in the team’s collective success. We share knowledge freely, lead with generosity, and practice empathy with our teammates, customers, and community.

Craft over Convention 

Our success relies on the quality and craft of the work we put into the world. The status quo simply won’t work. So we insist on narrow focus, sweating every detail, and relentless pursuit of customer delight.

Progress not Perfection 

Achieving our true potential — collectively and individually — requires constant progress and forward momentum. By creating a culture of curiosity and openness, we aim to create a safe space for mistakes, the ability to identify them quickly, and use them to get better.

Own the Outcome 

Own the outcome means taking full responsibility for the results of your work, decisions, and contributions. It reflects a mindset of accountability, proactiveness, and follow-through. If you “own the outcome,” you don’t just complete tasks, you ensure your work leads to meaningful results, and take initiative to solve problems rather than passing them along.

Read more about how we define, share, and live these values here .

Benefits And Perks

- 
Competitive salary and an internal, transparent salary formula based on market data

- 
Flexible time off – you choose the holidays and vacations that make sense for you

- 
12 weeks of fully paid parental leave for all new parents, including adoption and foster care

- 
A home office stipend to help you get set up and productive

- 
A co-working stipend up to $300 a month if you choose to work out of your house

- 
A yearly professional development stipend of $1,800 to help you grow in your craft

- 
If you’re in the U.S. or Canada, we offer top tier health insurance for you and your dependents.

Hiring Guidelines:

All roles at Help Scout are fully remote. Some positions have specific location requirements. For roles outside the U.S. and Canada, we work with teammates as independent contractors under country-specific agreements.

We do not sponsor visas. Teammates must already be authorized to work from their home country. 

We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to building a company that embraces and celebrates diversity and inclusion . We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. We have read the studies and understand that diverse teams build better products, bring more perspective to the table, contribute to a company’s financial success, and help foster a more inclusive environment for all employees, but the bottom line is that it's the right thing to do.

To provide you with the best experience, we can support you with accommodations or adjustments at any stage of the recruitment process. Simply inform our recruitment team during your conversation with them.

A note on the use of AI in our interview process

While we understand that AI is an important tool in a modern skillset, we ask that you do not utilize AI assistants live on our interviews. Of course, use any tools you need to prepare! But we'd like for you to have a real human-to-human conversation with our team.

On our end, we utilize a platform called Brighthire as a notetaker and review tool to ensure a fair and transparent hiring process.

Beware of scammers! All legitimate communication from Help Scout regarding your application will come directly from an @ helpscout.com email address and through our applicant tracking system, Ashby. We will never ask for personal financial information or conduct interviews outside of these official channels.

title: Senior Software Engineer - Data Factory (f/m/d)
description:
Notre Team Data Observability recherche un·e Senior Software Engineer basé·e à Lille ou Paris. 

Au cœur de l’entité Decathlon Digital, nous recherchons nos futur.es Senior Software Engineer pour rejoindre les équipes Data Factory.

Cette plateforme technologique, globale à tout le groupe de manière internationale, soutient le développement de l’usage de la Data chez Decathlon, du calcul du chiffre d’affaires à l’aide de conception de produits innovants.

Nous opérons une Modern Data Stack de pointe, avec un Lakehouse comme centre de gravité. Notre mission ? Garantir la scalabilité, l'automatisation et l'excellence des pratiques de développement pour l'ensemble de nos communautés (Data Engineers, Analysts, Scientists).

Notre équipe Data Observability est une brique essentielle de cette mission. Organisée autour de 3 axes clés, l'équipe Data Observability est chargée d'exposer le patrimoine de donnée de Decathlon ainsi que sa maturité au travers du Data cockpit. Nous mettons également à disposition les données core essentielles de lineage, de qualité et d'usage. Nous sommes une équipe qui valorise la collaboration, la montée en compétences et l'impact concret.

TA FUTURE CONTRIBUTION 

En tant que Senior Software Engineer au sein de l'équipe Data Observability, tu joueras un rôle clé dans la création et l'optimisation du data cockpit (alpha) pour nos équipes data platform, analytiques métier et pays. Notre mission est de créer la plateforme de discoverabilité et d'observabilité des données au sein de Decathlon (maturité de donnée, usage, lineage). Nous travaillons sur le produit qui répond à cette vision, le data cockpit .

Tes responsabilités comprendront :

- Leadership technique sur le data cokpit : Tu reprendras la stack technique pour le backend et le frontend du data cockpit et tu seras accompagnés de Data Engineer qui mette à disposition les jeux de données nécessaires au bon fonctionnement du produit.

- Data Governance automatisé : Tu prendras part à la mise en place de cette nouvelle approche au travers des data contract et du data cockpit.

- Compréhension des besoins fonctionnels : Proactivité dans l’analyse du besoin et la compréhension du quotidien des utilisateurs qu’on accompagne et de leur stakeholders.

- Support et accompagnement : Agir en tant qu'expert pour guider les équipes data dans l'utilisation correcte et efficace de nos produits d'observabilité 

- Promotion des bonnes pratiques : Contribuer activement à l'amélioration continue de nos méthodes de travail (mob programming, TDD, documentation robuste...) pour élever les standards techniques de l'équipe.

- Excellence opérationnelle : Mettre en œuvre des solutions de monitoring et d'automatisation pour réduire considérablement la charge de travail manuelle et améliorer l'efficacité globale de l'équipe.

L'équipe est composée de :

- 1 Product Manager

- 4 Data Engineers

STACK TECHNIQUE 

- Javascript : typescript 

- Cloud : AWS / Aiven 

- Queuing : Kafka 

- DB : PostgreSQL (Aurora) 

- Open Source framework : Great expectations, Open Lineage 

- CI/CD : Github, Github actions, Docker, K8s 

- Observability : Datadog, Prometheus, Grafana 

CE QUE TU APPORTES 

Nous recherchons un(e) Senior Full Stack Engineer avec une appétence pour comprendre les processus métiers , tourné(e) vers nos utilisateurs, en parallèle de solides compétences techniques.

Compétences techniques : 

- Expérience en programmation réactive

- Expérience significative dans le design, l'implémentation de bout en bout de solution solutions en mode micro-service

- Bonne connaissance des outils de monitoring et d’alerting.

- Une connaissance approfondie des systèmes de contrôle de version et d'intégration continue ( Git/Github ).

Compétences interpersonnelles et de collaboration : 

- Excellentes compétences en communication et documentation ainsi que d'un fort sens du service , avec une approche centrée sur l'utilisateur en suivant une logique Produit .

- Tu t'épanouis dans un environnement de travail agile et collaboratif (mob programming, revues de code...).

- Ta maîtrise de l' anglais te permet d'interagir facilement avec nos équipes et partenaires internationaux.

CE QUE NOUS T’OFFRONS 

- 2 jours de télétravail par semaine ;

- Possibilité de travailler dans l'un des bureaux de Decathlon Digital à Lille ou Paris ;

- Matériel performant fourni en accord avec tes missions et nos engagements sociétaux (Mac, Windows, ou Chromebooks) ;

- Une équipe de projet locale au sein d'un réseau mondial (possibilité de carrière internationale) ;

- Développement des compétences et accompagnement (diversité des projets, certifications techniques dès la première année, formations internes et externes, etc.) ;

There are a lot of moving pieces, which is exactly why we’re looking for someone who has built something like this before and gets excited about taking a platform from an idea to a working product, then continuing to grow it with us.

What You’ll Help Us Build

The platform will have two main sides: clients looking for services and contractors/vendors looking for business. 

Some of the functionality we’re planning includes:

- Client and contractor/vendor accounts and profiles

- Contractor listings, categories, search, and filtering

- Service requests, inquiries, referrals, and lead management

- Job and project tracking

- Client and vendor dashboards

- Online payments and transaction tracking

- Reviews and ratings

- Notifications and communications

- Banner advertising and paid promotional opportunities

- Admin tools for managing the platform

- Reporting and analytics

- Secure management of user, job, and transaction data

And probably more! We have a strong vision for where we want this to go, but we also want the right developer to help us determine the smartest way to build it.

This will be an evolving platform, so we’re looking for someone who wants to grow with it, not simply complete a checklist of features. 

Who We’re Looking For

We’d love to find someone with strong experience in full-stack web and mobile development , especially someone who has worked on a marketplace, booking platform, service-provider network, or another multi-user platform.

You should be comfortable with:

- Full-stack web development

- Strong front-end and back-end development

- Payment gateway integrations

More Than Just Coding

We’re not looking for someone who simply waits for a list of instructions and starts coding.

We want someone who can look at the big picture, ask the right questions, recommend the best technical approach, flag potential challenges, and help turn our ideas into a platform that’s intuitive, scalable, and built to grow.

You’ll also be expected to study established platforms like Thumbtack and Angi , understand how their user journeys and marketplace functionality work from both the client and service-provider sides, and use those learnings to help us determine the best approach for our own platform.

Weiterentwicklung

title: Senior Full Stack Engineer
description:
SAEKI - Manufacturing at software speed Europe's defense industrial base cannot respond at the speed modern conflict requires. Legacy suppliers operate on month-long timelines. Tribal knowledge is retiring. Supply chains are fragile. SAEKI is building the operating system for autonomous factories — the infrastructure that lets Europe manufacture mission-critical components at software speed. 

Every part we make generates data, decisions, and handoffs. Your job is to capture that knowledge, automate the work around it, and remove whatever slows production down. When a critical defense program needs parts by next week, the systems you build are why we can deliver. 

The Role As a Full-Stack Software Engineer on our manufacturing intelligence team, you'll work wherever the leverage is highest. One week that means turning an operator's spreadsheet into a proper workflow; the next it means wiring machine data into scheduling, or cutting a manual quoting step out of the order flow. 

You'll own problems end to end across our customer portal, Enterprise Resource Planning / Manufacturing Execution System, and the data layer connecting them to the shop floor. 

Based at our HQ at “The Circle” (Zurich airport), your work will span: 

- Manufacturing Intelligence: Capturing process, machine, and quality data so knowledge lives in systems instead of in people's heads. 

- Automation: Replacing manual steps in quoting, planning, scheduling, and documentation with software that runs on its own. 

- Production Acceleration: Finding the bottlenecks between CAD/CAM data submission and shipped parts. 

- Tools for People: Building interfaces that make life easier for operators, engineers, and customers, whether that's a work instruction screen, a dashboard, or a self-service portal. 

Importantly, you do not need prior experience in the manufacturing domain. We value a high level of curiosity and autonomy to find and solve problems. 

What We're Looking For - Experience: 3+ years as a software engineer with proven experience in shipping code to production, across backend and frontend 

- Broad Technical Range: Experience in systems design, architecture and implementation. In general, you don’t shy away from new technologies and pick up whatever the problem requires. Our current tech stack is: Rust, PostgreSQL, React, Python, AWS. 

- End-to-End Ownership: From talking to the user, to schema, to API, to UI, to rollout. You don't hand off "the other half." 

- Industrial Grit: Comfortable spending time on the shop floor in Germany to understand how work actually happens and how your software interacts with precision machinery. 

- Autonomy: You are comfortable with diving into new topics, coming up with solutions and driving their implementation 

- Bonus points: Knowledge of manufacturing and how factories operate, basic understanding of the Manufacturing Automation Pyramid 

- On-site: Ability to work in person at our HQ in Zurich, Switzerland. 

What we're not looking for - Engineers who only work on frontend or only work on backend. You must be comfortable across the full stack. 

- People who need detailed specs before they start building. You'll work directly with users and define the solution yourself. 

- Developers who ship code and move on. You own the outcome — not just the PR. 

- E ngineers who are uncomfortable with ambiguity or rapidly changing priorities. 

What we offer - Mission: Rebuild the industrial sovereignty of Europe . Your work directly enables the production of mission-critical hardware for defense and space 

- Total Ownership: High-stakes autonomy in your domain. You own both the problems and the solutions, and have the authority to execute. 

- The Environment: You are building solutions to accelerate production in a 5,000 m² state-of-the-art facility featuring 5-axis CNCs, industrial robots, and industrial plastic and metal 3D printers. Your work affects production of physical parts from day one. 

- The Team: Growing team of experienced software engineers, who value an open feedback culture. You may (and are expected to) challenge the status quo, prior decisions and drive SAEKI’s way forward. 

- Compensation: Competitive salary + meaningful equity. 

- Location: Zurich HQ with occasional travel to Factory ONE in Munich, Germany 

Apply - Resume: Focus on systems you've built and owned.

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience) and 6+ years of professional software engineering experience.

Full-stack experience designing and building backend services and APIs in a language such as Python, Java, Kotlin, Ruby, or Node.js.

- 
Track record of independently leading the design and delivery of large, business-critical frontend or full-stack projects in production.

- 
Ability to work effectively in ambiguous environments where product requirements, constraints, and system boundaries evolve over time.

- 
Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to explain technical tradeoffs and align product, design, and engineering partners.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience serving as the frontend or full-stack technical lead for a product team or business-critical product surface.

- 
Experience building consumer-facing products at scale with strong attention to performance, accessibility, and user experience.

- 
Background in fintech, lending, payments, or other regulated financial products with complex user journeys and high quality expectations.

- 
Experience with experimentation, A/B testing, or feature-flagging to drive iterative product improvements in production.

- 
Familiarity with modern frontend tooling and testing frameworks (e.g., Jest, React Testing Library, Cypress) and CI/CD workflows.

Hands-on experience leveraging generative AI in product features or internal engineering workflows.

- 
Passion for building products that expand access to credit and improve financial outcomes for consumers.
