title: Product Design Lead
description:
Fuel50 is a workforce transformation platform helping organisations understand workforce capability, build skills and enable internal mobility in an AI-driven world. Our products combine skills intelligence, talent marketplace experiences and responsible AI to help people and organisations take their next step.Â 

We are looking for a Product Design Lead to shape the next chapter of our product experience and design organisation.Â 

This is a senior player-coach role. You will lead and develop our product design team while staying close to the work, setting direction, shaping product strategy, prototyping ideas and helping teams ship high-quality experiences.Â 

You will work closely with Product and Engineering as a leadership trio, influencing decisions across the organisation and helping Fuel50 build products that are simple, trusted and valuable.Â 

If youâre a strategic design leader who still loves getting close to the work, developing people and shipping real product, weâd love to hear from you!Â 

What you'll do: - Lead, manage and coach our product designers, supporting their growth and helping them reach their next level.Â 
- Set and communicate a clear product design vision across Fuel50's skills intelligence, talent mobility and AI-powered experiences, and tell the story of where our products are going in a way that excites customers, colleagues and leadership.Â 
- Own the design direction without waiting for it to be handed to you. Spot opportunities, form a point of view, and prototype ideas to make them tangible.Â 
- Bring a strong point of view to senior conversations, challenge assumptions constructively and influence decisions across the business.Â 
- Partner with Product and Engineering from discovery through to delivery, balancing customer value, design quality, technical reality and pace.Â 
- Design human-centred AI experiences with appropriate trust, explainability, user control and clear handoffs, including agent and assistant experiences that work across multiple surfaces such as the Fuel50 platform, Microsoft Teams and Copilot.Â 
- Grow our design engineering capability, and be comfortable building and shipping working prototypes or code yourself.Â 
- Evolve our design system, accessibility standards (including WCAG compliance) and design-to-code practices so Fuel50 feels coherent and high quality across every product.Â 
- Shape design team structure, capability, hiring, planning and ways of working as the organisation evolves.Â 

What you'll bring: - Experience in product design in a SaaS or technology environment (we suggest 7 or more years), including at least 2 years leading, managing or coaching designers, and a track record of building healthy, high-performing teams.Â 
- Strong product design craft across discovery, interaction design, visual design, prototyping, research and shipped digital products.Â 
- Experience designing complex, connected systems and journeys for multiple personas, ideally in an enterprise or B2B product.Â 
- The ability to think big and set a compelling vision, while staying pragmatic about what can be learned and shipped next.Â 
- The ability to originate ideas and direction, and to communicate them clearly through stories, prototypes and design narrative.Â 
- Confidence working with experienced senior stakeholders and influencing through clarity, judgement and strong communication.Â 
- Experience working closely with Product and Engineering as a genuine cross-functional trio.Â 
- Technical fluency and a willingness to get into the code. You should be comfortable building working prototypes using HTML, CSS, JavaScript or similar tools, and have contributed code that has shipped to production, for example front-end changes or design system components submitted through pull requests.Â 
- Hands-on experience using AI coding and design tools, such as Claude Code, Codex or Cursor, to prototype faster and ship real work. We want someone who uses these tools well and can show how they have changed the way their team works.Â 
- Working knowledge of accessibility and WCAG. You have designed to WCAG standards, tested for it, and built accessibility into your team's design system and review process.Â 
- An interest in design systems and data-informed decision-making.Â 
You do not need to tick every box. We care about the quality of your thinking, the way you work with people and your ability to turn ambitious ideas into better product experiences.Â 

All Fuellies are a core part of our culture and making Fuel50 an amazing place to work. Some additional benefits are:Â Â 

- A day off on your birthday and your Fuel50 anniversaryÂ 
- A âReFuel Dayâ once a quarter to relax and refuelÂ 
- Remote work and flexible work times - we're supportive of school commitments, traveling in off-peak hours, and attending to lifeâs eventsÂ 
- A progressive parental leave policyÂ 
- Comprehensive fully subsidised health insurance with Southern CrossÂ 
What's it like to be a Fuellie? Fuel50âs team is fully remote, with an HQ in New Zealand, and team members across five countries. We have a co-working space in the BHive in Takapuna that we use to meet occasionally for team and strategic planning and other team events. If youâre based outside of Auckland and are needed on-site for anything, weâll pay for you to get here.Â 

We know that having the right people with the right attitude and behaviour is a big part of what makes us successful.Â Living our values is an important part of being successful in this role.Â Â 

- We have a culture around continuous and respectful feedback and recognition - be part of a team working towards a common goal and helping each other every step of the way.Â Â 
- We have #SuperheroAwards at quarterly planning meetings and spontaneous recognition and shout-outs across the business.Â Â 
- We'll have your back when you need help - your colleagues want to see you succeed and work hard to help you do so.Â Â

Application process: If this sounds like you, then please apply. If youâre not sure you're ready or perhaps you don't meet all requirements yet, please apply anyway. We'll review every application that we get.Â Â 

Please include a link to your portfolio or attach it as part of your application.Â 

This role is based in New Zealand, candidates must hold the relevant right to work in NZ i.e. Citizenship or a work visa at the time of application.Â

title: Staff Quality Assurance Engineer
description:
About IonQ: 

IonQ, Inc . [NYSE: IONQ] is the world’s leading quantum platform and merchant supplier - delivering integrated quantum solutions across computing, networking, sensing, and security. IonQ’s newest generation of quantum computers, the IonQ Tempo, is the latest in a line of cutting-edge systems that have been helping customers and partners including Amazon Web Services, and AstraZeneca achieve 20x performance results and accelerate innovation in drug discovery, materials science, financial modeling, logistics, cybersecurity, and defense. In 2025, the company achieved 99.99% two-qubit gate fidelity, setting a world record in quantum computing performance .

Headquartered in College Park, Maryland, IonQ has operations in California, Colorado, Massachusetts, Tennessee, Washington, Italy, South Korea, Sweden, Switzerland, Canada, and the United Kingdom. Our quantum computing services are available through all major cloud providers, while we also meet the needs of networking and sensing customers across land, sea, air, and space. IonQ is making quantum platforms more accessible and impactful than ever before. 

Location: This role is based onsite in Geneva, Switzerland.
Travel: 
Job ID: 1917 

The Role: 

We are looking for a Staff QA Engineer to join our team building post-quantum cryptography (PQC) hardware acceleration for HSM and network-appliance products. You will own product-level quality assurance: the system test plans, automation and compliance test execution that stand between an engineering release and a product customers can trust. In a security product, QA is not an afterthought; it is part of the evidence.

Responsibilities :

You will define and execute system-level test plans for FPGA-based cryptographic products: functional, performance, stress, stability and negative testing across the full stack, from hardware through firmware and drivers to cryptographic APIs. You will build and maintain the automated QA infrastructure (regression suites, hardware-in-the-loop test benches, CI integration, results dashboards), execute standards-based compliance test campaigns (NIST ACVP/CAVP test vectors, FIPS 140-3 evidence runs, CNSA 2.0 checklists and standard FPGA compliance tests) together with our verification and security engineers, run interoperability testing against protocol stacks and customer-representative configurations, own defect tracking and triage, and define the release-qualification criteria for every product release.

- Own system-level QA of cryptographic hardware products: test plans, automation, execution and release qualification

- Execute standards and compliance test campaigns (ACVP/CAVP vectors, FIPS 140-3 evidence, CNSA 2.0 and FPGA compliance tests) as part of the certification effort

Requirements: 

We are looking for a candidate with a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering or a related field (or equivalent experience) and at least five years in quality assurance or system test of embedded, hardware or networking products. You have built test automation in Python or similar, integrated it into CI, and worked hands-on with lab equipment and hardware-in-the-loop setups.

Exposure to security or compliance testing (FIPS, Common Criteria, or telecom/industrial certification regimes) is a strong plus, as is experience testing cryptographic or networking functionality. title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
Als Senior Data Engineer bij BigData Republic adviseer je toonaangevende organisaties in Nederland over complexe data-vraagstukken. Je combineert hands-on engineering met een adviserende rol: je schrijft productie-klare code, denkt mee over strategische bedrijfsbeslissingen en begeleidt collega’s om naar een hoger niveau te groeien.

Je hebt je carrière opgebouwd rond het ontwerpen en bouwen van datasystemen. Je werkt graag inhoudelijk mee, maar verliest kwaliteit, schaalbaarheid en duurzaamheid nooit uit het oog. Je bent een ervaren Data Engineer die vaak moeilijk in één functie te vatten is, omdat je op meerdere niveaus impact maakt. En je bent toe aan een nieuwe uitdaging.

Bij BigData Republic ontwikkelen we data-applicaties, bouwen we data-platformen, creëren we voorspellende modellen en ontwerpen we robuuste data-infrastructuren. We werken vanuit een software-engineering mindset, met focus op technische hoogstaande kwaliteit.

Kennisdeling en thought leadership vormen de kern van onze cultuur. Elke vrijdag organiseren we kennissessies op kantoor, we schrijven blogs, organiseren meetups en bezoeken en spreken op conferenties.

Je werkt aan complexe projecten voor grote klanten in uiteenlopende sectoren, terwijl je onderdeel bent van een klein, informeel en hecht team van vakgenoten dat elkaar uitdaagt en inspireert. Bij BigData Republic ben je de expert in de kamer én leer je elke dag van je collega’s. En vooral: je kunt hier jezelf zijn.

In de praktijk besteed je ongeveer 90% van je tijd aan klantprojecten. De overige tijd is expliciet gereserveerd voor eigen initiatieven: een pet project, innovatie of een idee dat je samen met collega’s wilt uitwerken.

Je past goed bij deze rol als je ervaring hebt met (een deel van) onderstaande tooling en concepten:

Je hebt een sterke basis in;

- Python

- Cloud (AWS, GCP of Azure)

- Data pipelines bouwen en ouderhouden (ELT/ ETL)

- Data warehousing (Databricks, Snowflake of BigQuery)

- Orchestratie (Airflow, Dagster)

- Terraform, CI/ CD

Pluspunten, maar geen vereiste:

- Streaming (Kafka, Spark, Flink)

- DevOps (Kubernetes)

- Data Governance en management (bijvoorbeeld dbt)

- Ervaring met AI en of ML infrastructuur (feature stores, vector databases, ML pipelines)

Je hoeft niet alles te beheersen. Nieuwsgierigheid, leergierigheid en technische diepgang vinden we belangrijker dan een perfecte checklist.

Benefits 

- Salaris tussen €5.500 en €6.700 bruto per maand (op basis van 40 uur), afhankelijk van kennis, ervaring en senioriteit

- Vakantiegeld, 8%

- Lease- en Mobiliteitsbudget van €925 per maand

- Bonus- en pensioenregeling

- 25 Vakantiedagen

- Hybride werken: de juiste balans tussen thuis, kantoor en klant

- Vrije keuze in laptop en telefoon

- Ruimte voor kennisdeling, certificeringen en conferentiebezoek (haal die badge!)

- Vrijdagmiddagborrels, sportactiviteiten en sociale events (vrijblijvend)

- Uitdagende én leuke projecten bij aansprekende klanten

- Een informele cultuur met ruimte voor initiatief en innovatie

CAO & arbeidsvoorwaarden
Conflux is aangesloten bij de Vereniging van Detacheerders Nederland (VvDN); op deze functie is de CAO voor Detacheerders Nederland (VvDN) van toepassing.

Over BigData Republic 
BigData Republic is een high-end consultancybureau gespecialiseerd in data science, data engineering en machine learning. We zijn AI-native en combineren dit met diepgaande engineering kennis. Op deze manier bieden wij onze klanten technische begeleiding tot duurzame en innovatieve oplossingen. Als niche-consultancyteam onderscheiden we ons van de grote spelers: we leveren kwaliteit boven kwantiteit en willen een thought leader in ons vakgebied zijn. Voor onze klanten richten we ons op het creëren van businesswaarde met innovatieve datasolutions die een duurzame impact hebben. Kennisdeling en thought leadership zijn fundamentele pijlers van onze organisatie: elke vrijdag organiseren we kennissessies op kantoor, we schrijven blogposts, organiseren meetups en bezoeken conferenties. title: Solutions Architect (EST or PST hours)
description:
Company Overview 

Deepgram is the leading platform underpinning the emerging trillion-dollar Voice AI economy, providing real-time APIs for speech-to-text (STT), text-to-speech (TTS), and building production-grade voice agents at scale. More than 200,000 developers and 1,300+ organizations build voice offerings that are ‘Powered by Deepgram’, including Twilio, Cloudflare, Sierra, Decagon, Vapi, Daily, Cresta, Granola, and Jack in the Box. Deepgram’s voice-native foundation models are accessed through cloud APIs or as self-hosted and on-premises software, with unmatched accuracy, low latency, and cost efficiency. Backed by a recent Series C led by leading global investors and strategic partners, Deepgram has processed over 50,000 years of audio and transcribed more than 1 trillion words. There is no organization in the world that understands voice better than Deepgram.

Company Operating Rhythm 

At Deepgram, we expect an AI-first mindset—AI use and comfort aren’t optional, they’re core to how we operate, innovate, and measure performance.

Every team member who works at Deepgram is expected to actively use and experiment with advanced AI tools, and even build your own into your everyday work. We measure how effectively AI is applied to deliver results, and consistent, creative use of the latest AI capabilities is key to success here. Candidates should be comfortable adopting new models and modes quickly, integrating AI into their workflows, and continuously pushing the boundaries of what these technologies can do.

Additionally, we move at the pace of AI. Change is rapid, and you can expect your day-to-day work to evolve just as quickly. This may not be the right role if you’re not excited to experiment, adapt, think on your feet, and learn constantly, or if you’re seeking something highly prescriptive with a traditional 9-to-5.

Note: This individual must be based in either Eastern or Pacific Time in the US. or willing to work during these time zone work hours

Opportunity
Deepgram is seeking a talented, support-focused Solutions Architect (Applied Engineer) to join our Applied Engineering (AppEng) team. In this role, you will directly engage with customers to solve complex technical challenges while simultaneously building scalable solutions that enhance our support infrastructure. You'll own complete customer engagements in a post-sales capacity, and occasionally assist with pre-sales and implementation projects as needed. Your strong engineering background will enable you to resolve sophisticated technical issues, create repeatable solutions, and develop automation that allows the broader AppEng team to focus on high-impact pre-sales activities. This position offers an excellent path to grow into broader implementation and pre-sales roles while making an immediate impact on our customer support experience. As a key member of the Applied Engineering team, you'll influence our customer support strategy, and play a crucial role in ensuring our customers receive exceptional technical assistance throughout their journey with Deepgram.

About Applied Engineering at Deepgram
The Applied Engineering (AppEng) team at Deepgram combines the functions that other companies might separate into Solutions Engineering, Sales Engineering, Implementation, and Technical Support. We serve as the technical interface between Deepgram and our customers throughout their entire journey, from initial discovery and proof-of-concept, through implementation and onboarding, to ongoing technical support. We work closely with our Customer Success and Developer Experience (DX) teams to ensure a positive, growth-focused experience for our customers. This unified approach allows us to provide comprehensive technical guidance and build deeper relationships with our customers. As a support-focused Applied Engineer, you'll be primarily concerned with elevating our technical support capabilities while having opportunities to contribute to the broader Applied Engineering mission in pre-sales, implementation, and more.

What you'll do 

- 
Own the technical design and delivery of customer implementations and migrations, from kickoff through production cutover

- 
Lead deployment scaling work, including capacity planning, rollout sequencing, and verification methodology

- 
Design solutions that fit each customer's existing stack, constraints, and operational shape

- 
Partner with Customer Success and Account Executives on customer-side change management, including readiness, stakeholder alignment, and rollout communication

- 
Develop reusable implementation patterns, reference architectures, and deployment playbooks that the broader AppEng team and customers can reuse

- 
Create automation and self-service tooling that compresses time-to-value for repeatable implementation work

- 
Collaborate with product and engineering teams to advocate for customer needs and influence the roadmap based on patterns observed in active deployments

- 
Provide support for the most complex post-onboarding cases when escalation crosses into Solutions Architect territory

- 
Occasionally support pre-sales technical work, including discovery, scoping, and proof-of-concept design

Time allocation 

- 
50% — Customer implementation and scaling engagements

- 
20% — Building reusable patterns, reference architectures, and automation

- 
15% — Pre-sales technical support, including discovery, demos, and proof-of-concepts

- 
10% — Documentation and knowledge sharing

- 
5% — Complex post-onboarding escalations and collaboration with Technical Support Engineers

Your first 90 days 

- 
First 30 days — Complete comprehensive onboarding to understand Deepgram's technology, products, and the patterns we use for implementations. Gain proficiency with our core APIs and documentation. Shadow active implementation engagements to build familiarity with how the AppEng team operates during customer change phases.

- 
60 days — Begin owning customer implementation engagements end-to-end, leading technical design and partnering with Customer Success on rollout. Start contributing to reusable implementation patterns and reference architectures.

- 
90 days — Own the technical delivery of multiple concurrent customer implementations. Develop and deliver scalable solutions for repeatable customer change patterns. Begin contributing to the Applied Engineering team's implementation methodology and mentoring newer team members.

You'll love this role if you... 

- 
Enjoy seeing customer technical environments transformed through careful implementation work

- 
Are passionate about reducing the time it takes any customer to reach production value with Deepgram

- 
Find satisfaction in designing patterns that scale beyond a single customer engagement

- 
Have a talent for identifying recurring needs across customers and translating them into reusable artifacts

- 
Are energized by deploying cutting-edge Voice AI in production environments with real customers

- 
See implementation work as a strategic function that drives customer growth and retention

It's important to us that you have 

- 
3+ years of experience implementing or deploying technical solutions for enterprise customers, ideally in customer-facing technical roles

- 
Strong software engineering background with professional development experience in at least one modern programming language, such as Python, JavaScript / TypeScript, Rust, C / C++, or similar languages

- 
Experience leading technical delivery of production deployments, from design through cutover

- 
Proven ability to scope complex technical work and sequence it for successful delivery

- 
Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to explain technical concepts clearly to engineering and business stakeholders alike

It would be great if you had 

- 
Experience with speech recognition, natural language processing, AI Voice agents, or related AI technologies

- 
Knowledge of cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure) and containerization technologies like Docker and Kubernetes

- 
Experience with API-first products and developer tools

- 
Background in change-management or implementation methodology

- 
Experience producing reference architectures, deployment playbooks, or implementation templates

Notice : We're aware of individuals impersonating Deepgram recruiters. All legitimate Deepgram recruiting communication comes from an @ deepgram.com email address. If you've received a message claiming to be Deepgram, please forward it to careers@deepgram.com.

Wil jij verantwoordelijkheid dragen voor complexe dataplatformen, technische richting bepalen binnen projecten en klanten helpen bij het vertalen van data-architectuur naar schaalbare oplossingen?

De Senior Data Engineer neemt een leidende rol in het naar een hoger niveau brengen van de data-architectuur, datahandling en data-automatiseringsmogelijkheden van onze klanten. Daarnaast pas je jouw technische leiderschap, ervaring en visie toe om robuuste, efficiënte en herbruikbare data-oplossingen te realiseren en collega’s hierin mee te nemen.

Wij zoeken iemand die: 

- De lead neemt in het ontwerpen, bouwen en bewaken van herbruikbare datamodellen en data-architecturen.

- Complexe datapijplijnen ontwikkelt, waaronder ETL/ELT-processen

- Data lakes en data warehouses ontwerpt en optimaliseert.

- Analysemethoden en data science-oplossingen operationaliseert en vertaalt naar productieklare toepassingen.

- De benodigde cloudinfrastructuur ontwerpt, inricht en beheert, inclusief aandacht voor performance, security en schaalbaarheid.

- Ervaring heeft met werken in een commercieel gerichte en/of consulting organisatie en klanten kan adviseren op strategisch en technisch niveau.

- Graag werkt in een teamsetting met collega’s met verschillende vaardigheden en actief bijdraagt aan kennisdeling en coaching.

- Zich thuis voelt in een omgeving met zeer gemotiveerde mensen die zich richten op het leveren van de hoogste kwaliteit aan klanten.

Over het Data & AI team 
Wij helpen onze klanten innoveren en gebruikmaken van de nieuwste data- en AI-technologie. Ons Data & AI-team bestaat uit ruim 40 data-experts, waaronder Data Scientists, Data Engineers en Consultants. Samen realiseren zij innovatieve data-, analytics- en AI-oplossingen voor klanten in Retail, Financial Services en Health. 

Het team groeit snel en heeft de ambitie om verder uit te bouwen tot een van de meest toonaangevende Data & AI-praktijken van Nederland. Die groei komt voort uit ons succes: klanten kiezen steeds vaker voor IG&H vanwege onze combinatie van strategisch inzicht, technische expertise en pragmatische executie. We werken aan projecten die direct bijdragen aan betere besluitvorming, efficiëntere processen en nieuwe businessmodellen.

title: Backend Engineer (Multiple Positions)
description:
Headquarters: Remote - US

Backend Engineer 

About LaunchDarkly Engineering 

LaunchDarkly helps engineering organizations ship software and AI with speed, safety, and control. Our platform gives teams the confidence to release gradually, target experiences to the right audiences, learn through experimentation, understand what is happening in production, and respond quickly when risk appears.

Our engineers build the systems, services, SDKs, developer tools, cloud infrastructure, and product experiences that make this possible. The work spans high-scale distributed systems, reliable data and event pipelines, intuitive enterprise workflows, and AI-powered capabilities that help teams manage the next generation of software delivery.

LaunchDarkly’s SDKs are used in systems that perform trillions of feature flag evaluations each day, giving our engineering work a direct connection to the reliability and customer experience of software around the world. As the company grows, we are expanding beyond traditional feature management into experimentation, observability, and AgentControl—helping customers control more of the software and AI lifecycle. That creates an unusually broad set of technical challenges, visible customer impact, and room for engineers to shape what comes next.

We believe in the power of teams. We work with humility, openness, curiosity, and care; we value clear communication, thoughtful technical judgment, inclusive collaboration, and a strong sense of ownership. We encourage people to apply even when they do not meet every qualification listed below. We are interested in the experience, perspective, and potential you would bring to the role.

About the role 

We have multiple backend engineering roles open on various teams. The specific level, scope, and technical focus will be aligned to the opportunity and the candidate’s experience. Experience with cloud platforms, distributed systems, developer tools, SDK engineering, data infrastructure, observability, or AI/agent systems may be relevant for some teams.

As a Backend Engineer at LaunchDarkly, you will design, build, and operate the services that power reliable software delivery for our customers. You may work on APIs, distributed systems, configuration and event pipelines, data services, SDK-related infrastructure, platform capabilities, or backend systems supporting our product experiences.

You will work with experienced engineers, Product, Design, and partner teams to turn customer and business needs into simple, scalable solutions. You will have the opportunity to own work from early design through production, learn from real customer impact, and contribute to systems that operate at meaningful scale.

What you’ll do 

- Design, implement, test, and operate production services and APIs.

- Lead projects or meaningful components of projects from problem definition through deployment and iteration.

- Make thoughtful tradeoffs across scalability, performance, reliability, security, maintainability, and delivery speed.

- Improve the observability and operability of the systems you own, including metrics, logs, traces, alerting, and incident learnings.

- Collaborate with Product, Design, Support, Customer Success, and other engineering teams to understand needs and deliver useful outcomes.

- Participate in technical design discussions and code reviews, sharing constructive feedback and learning from teammates.

- Investigate production issues calmly and help turn operational lessons into lasting improvements.

- Contribute to a culture of inclusive collaboration, continuous improvement, and high-quality engineering.

Qualifications 

- 5+ years of experience building and operating production software in a professional environment, or equivalent demonstrable experience.

- Strong software engineering fundamentals, including data structures, algorithms, testing, debugging, and API design.

- Experience with a backend language such as Go, Python, Rust, or an equivalent language. (Most of our teams use Go) 

- Experience designing or contributing to services that need to be reliable, observable, and maintainable as usage grows.

- Ability to explain technical decisions and tradeoffs clearly to both technical and non-technical partners.

- A collaborative approach and a sense of ownership for both your work and its downstream customer impact.

- Comfort learning unfamiliar systems and working through ambiguous problems.

Pay: 

Target pay ranges based on Geographic Zones* for Level 3: 

- Zone 1: San Francisco/Bay Area or NYC Metropolitan Area, Boston, Seattle - $171,200 - $235,400**

- Zone 2: Irvine, LA, Monterey, Santa Barbara, Santa Rosa, Austin, Portland, Philadelphia, Chicago - $154,100 - $211,860 **

- Zone 3: All other US locations - $ 145,500 - $200,090 **

LaunchDarkly operates from a place of high trust and transparency; we are happy to state the pay range for our open roles to best align with your needs. Exact compensation may vary based on skills, experience, and location. 

*Within the United States, our geographic pay zones are defined by counties surrounding major metropolitan areas. 
**Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), health, vision, and dental insurance, and mental health benefits in addition to salary. 

About LaunchDarkly: 

Modern software delivery was supposed to be the foundation for a thriving digital business but reality has proven otherwise. Slow, inefficient development cycles, costly outages, and fragmented customer experiences are preventing developers from building their best software. The LaunchDarkly platform helps developers innovate on new features faster while protecting them with a safety valve to instantly rewind when things go wrong. Developers can target product experiences to any customer segment and maximize the business impact of every feature. And by gradually rolling out new application components, they escape nightmare "big-bang" technology migrations. 

The LaunchDarkly platform was built to guide engineers to the next frontier of DevOps by:

- Improving the velocity and stability of software releases, without the fear of end customer outages

- Delivering targeted experiences by easily personalizing features to customer cohorts

- Maximizing the business impact of every feature through the ability to experiment and optimize

- Coordinating the release and optimization of software to provide consistent experiences across mobile platforms and device types

- Improving the effectiveness and productivity of engineering teams, by providing insights into engineering cadence and stability

At LaunchDarkly, we believe in the power of teams. We're building a team that is humble, open, collaborative, respectful and kind. We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. LD invites any applicant to review our written Affirmative Action Plan. To do so, contact People Ops at hr@launchdarkly.com . 

Do you need a disability accommodation? 

Fill out this accommodations request form and someone from our People Operations team will contact you for assistance. 

Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, LaunchDarkly recruiters will only contact you from @ launchdarkly.com email addresses or via LinkedIn from "Verified Recruiter" accounts. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate LaunchDarkly recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before making a job offer. LaunchDarkly will never make a job offer without conducting a formal interview process. Our interview process does not involve asking detailed questions by email. If you are ever unsure about a communication that you receive, don't click any links—visit Careers | LaunchDarkly directly for confirmed job openings and links to apply.

Please notify us of any fraudulent representation by sending an email to careers@launchdarkly.com .

title: Senior Information Security Infrastructure Engineer - Security Architecture - InfoSec
description:
Elastic, the Search AI Company, enables everyone to find the answers they need in real time, using all their data, at scale — unleashing the potential of businesses and people. The Elastic Search AI Platform, used by more than 50% of the Fortune 500, brings together the precision of search and the intelligence of AI to enable everyone to accelerate the results that matter. By taking advantage of all structured and unstructured data — securing and protecting private information more effectively — Elastic’s complete, cloud-based solutions for search, security, and observability help organizations deliver on the promise of AI.

What is The Role : 

Join the InfoSec - Security Architecture team as a Senior Information Security Infrastructure Engineer , where you'll have the chance to play a key role in protecting our organization's data and systems. This position offers the opportunity to work on meaningful projects that directly impact our security posture and collaborate with a skilled team passionate about information security. 

In more details: We ingest the security telemetry that the whole security org runs on. In this role you'll get that telemetry into Elasticsearch consistently and keep the underlying Elastic clusters healthy. You own the pipeline end to end: from a new security data source landing, through ingest pipelines, into the indices detection, IR, and consulting teams query, plus the clusters that store it all. 

What You Will Be Doing : 

- 
Security telemetry ingestion - build and maintain ingestion of security-relevant data into Elasticsearch (cloud provider audit logs, identity/SaaS activity, endpoint and asset data). This means integrating with third-party and cloud provider APIs to pull telemetry: auth, pagination, rate limits, and handling schema changes. Both Elastic integrations and one-off custom integrations. 

- 
Keep the Elastic Cloud on Kubernetes clusters healthy. Monitor and upgrade them regularly. This involves updating versions and builds. Manage capacity and shards. Handle index lifecycle management (ILM). Enable cross-cluster search (CCS). 

- 
Use Terraform to manage cloud infrastructure and Elasticsearch resources. This includes managing pipelines, index templates, and alerts. Utilize Kubernetes and Helm to deploy scheduled ingest jobs. 

- 
Use AI automation and tooling to reduce toil. This includes self-healing jobs and health checks. It also involves alerting, internal CLIs, and AI or agent-assisted workflows for investigation and operations. 

- 
Data quality & reliability - Own the "is the security data actually flowing correctly?" question. Monitor backfills. Ensure that schemas and fields are consistent. Keep an eye on costs. 

What You Bring : 

- 
Ability to operate Elastic and Elasticsearch in production. This includes managing ingest pipelines, index templates, mappings, and queries, while ensuring that clusters are healthy and upgraded. Experience with ECK or Elasticsearch on Kubernetes is strongly preferred. 

- 
Proven track record of using AI to accelerate development, debug complex systems, and accelerate operations, while still owning the final outcomes. 

- 
Kubernetes - deploying and operating workloads (scheduled jobs, Helm charts, operators); troubleshooting pods/jobs in a cluster. 

- 
Terraform - managing cloud and Elasticsearch resources as code. 

- 
API integration - consuming REST APIs for data ingestion: authentication, pagination, rate limiting concurrency, and error handling. 

- 
Python scripting - able to read, write, and modify ingestion/automation scripts. Scripting-level, not full software-engineering depth. 

Bonus Points : 

- 
Experience with cloud providers. 

- 
Hands-on experience with cloud providers, preferably GCP, and working with audit and logging data. 

- 
Knowledge of GitHub, PR-based workflows, GitHub Actions and Continuous Integration (CI). 

- 
Knowledge of SOC operations and incident response (IR) workflows, including the use of security telemetry during investigations. 

- 
Ability to develop and use dashboard/visualization tools. 

Additional Information - We Take Care of Our People 

As a distributed company, diversity drives our identity. Whether you’re looking to launch a new career or grow an existing one, Elastic is the type of company where you can balance great work with great life. Your age is only a number. It doesn’t matter if you’re just out of college or your children are; we need you for what you can do.

We strive to have parity of benefits across regions and while regulations differ from place to place, we believe taking care of our people is the right thing to do.

- Competitive pay based on the work you do here and not your previous salary

- Health coverage for you and your family in many locations

- Ability to craft your calendar with flexible locations and schedules for many roles

- Generous number of vacation days each year

- Increase your impact - We match up to $2000 (or local currency equivalent) for financial donations and service

- Up to 40 hours each year to use toward volunteer projects you love

- Embracing parenthood with minimum of 16 weeks of parental leave

Different people approach problems differently. We need that. Elastic is an equal opportunity/affirmative action employer committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, ethnicity, color, religion, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender perception or identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, disability status, or any other basis protected by federal, state or local law, ordinance or regulation.

Applicants have rights under Federal Employment Laws, view posters linked below: Family and Medical Leave Act (FMLA) Poster; Pay Transparency Nondiscrimination Provision Poster; Employee Polygraph Protection Act (EPPA) Poster and Know Your Rights (Poster)

title: Senior Technical SEO Specialist
description:
Who We Are 

WPP Enterprise Solutions designs, builds, and operates the growth systems that competitive businesses rely on. In a world where Al is reshaping how companies drive growth, we lead clients in business transformation and marketing modernization, connecting strategy directly to execution. Our 12,000 experts in engineering and platforms, commerce, consulting, content transformation, CRM, and CX work within a unified global operating unit across 40+ markets. WPP Enterprise Solutions works alongside best-in-class partners including Adobe, AWS, Braze, Google, Microsoft, Salesforce, and Shopify, as well as innovators in AI, to deliver growth solutions tailored to the needs of our clients’ businesses. VML, part of WPP, supports WPP Enterprise Solutions by helping brands activate transformation through creativity and experience.

About the role 

WPP Enterprise Solutions in Amsterdam is the central hub for SEO and GEO expertise across the WPP network. From our team, we work with major national and international organisations on complex challenges across search, websites, digital platforms and AI-driven discovery.

Our team currently consists of ten SEO and GEO specialists and is growing rapidly. We are therefore looking for a Senior Technical SEO Specialist to strengthen our technical capabilities.

This is explicitly not a traditional SEO role with some technical SEO added on top. We are looking for someone who approaches SEO from a technical perspective. Someone who understands how websites, platforms, JavaScript frameworks, crawlers, rendering, APIs and search engines interact, and who can independently investigate and solve complex technical problems.

You are comfortable working with SEO specialists, developers, solution architects, product teams and other technical stakeholders. You are able to go deep into the technology when needed, while also translating complex findings into clear priorities, recommendations and implementations for enterprise clients.

What you will do 

As a Senior Technical SEO Specialist, you will be responsible for the technical quality and scalability of our SEO solutions. You will work on complex websites and digital ecosystems where standard SEO checklists are simply not enough.

Your responsibilities will include: 

- Conducting advanced technical SEO audits for large and complex websites, platforms and international domain structures.

- Analysing crawling, indexing and rendering to identify the root causes of technical SEO and indexation issues.

- Working with modern JavaScript frameworks and rendering architectures, including SSR, CSR, SSG and hybrid rendering.

- Analysing HTML, JavaScript, HTTP requests, response headers, status codes, redirects, canonicalisation and robots directives.

- Investigating and optimising crawl architecture, internal linking and information architecture for websites with hundreds of thousands or millions of URLs.

- Advising on complex technical challenges involving migrations, replatforming, URL structures, faceted navigation, pagination, internationalisation and hreflang.

- Performing log file analysis to understand how Googlebot and other crawlers interact with websites and to improve crawl efficiency.

- Developing scripts, tooling and automation that make recurring analyses faster, more reliable and more scalable.

- Reviewing technical solutions, specifications and implementations from an SEO perspective before they go live.

- Working closely with developers and engineering teams to translate SEO recommendations into clear technical requirements and tickets.

The technical expertise we are looking for 

For this role, we are looking for someone whose technical capabilities go well beyond using standard SEO tools.

You have a strong understanding of: 

- HTML, CSS and JavaScript, and can independently analyse source code and identify technical issues.

- HTTP and web architecture, including requests and responses, status codes, caching, redirects, headers and CDN behaviour.

- JavaScript SEO and the implications of client-side and server-side rendering for crawling, rendering and indexing.

- Technical concepts such as SSR, CSR, SSG, hydration and dynamic rendering.

- Crawling and indexing, and how search engines technically process websites.

- txt, XML sitemaps, canonical tags, meta robots, X-Robots-Tag and other crawling and indexing directives.

- Structured data and Schema.org.

- Core Web Vitals and web performance.

- International websites, hreflang and complex multi-market architectures.

- Website and platform migrations.

- Crawl budget and scalable website architectures.

You do not need to be a software engineer in every area. However, we do expect you to be comfortable reading code, manipulating data, working with APIs and building scripts or technical solutions when needed.

What seniority means to us

Being senior means more than being able to independently deliver a technical SEO audit.

We expect you to be able to break down complex technical problems where there is no obvious answer. You combine experience, data and technical knowledge to define your own investigative approach and develop solutions that can realistically scale within enterprise organisations.

You will also:

- Proactively improve the way we work, using tooling and AI to increase efficiency, quality and impact.

- Make significant improvements to our SEO guidelines, workflows and processes.

- Develop innovative solutions to complex SEO challenges, including algorithm changes, large-scale site architecture, crawling and automation.

- Build frameworks, templates, scripts and automations that can be adopted across multiple clients and projects.

- Independently develop new approaches for challenges where no standard solution exists.

- Think beyond what needs to change and consider how solutions can be technically and organisationally implemented at scale.

- Help other SEO specialists grow their technical capabilities.

Act as a senior technical sparring partner for our clients.

What you'll need: 

- 10+ years of experience in Technical SEO, with a strong track record of solving complex technical SEO challenges for large-scale, international and/or enterprise websites.

- Currently based in the Netherlands and able to work from our WPP office in Amsterdam.

- Deep technical knowledge of how modern websites are built, crawled, rendered and indexed, including strong expertise in HTML, JavaScript, HTTP, web architecture and rendering technologies.

- Strong experience working with l arge and complex website architectures, including crawling and indexation, faceted navigation, internationalisation, migrations, internal linking and crawl budget optimisation.

- Experience with Python and/or JavaScript for scripting and automation is highly desirable, as is experience with SQL, BigQuery or comparable data environments.

- A proven ability to turn complex technical findings into clear, actionable recommendations for developers, product teams, architects and senior stakeholders.

- Experience developing scalable frameworks, tooling, templates or automations that can be applied across multiple clients or projects.

- An eager and proactive mindset, with a strong interest in exploring how AI, automation, emerging search technologies and GEO can improve both our work and our clients' performance.

- Fluent in English. Dutch is highly desirable.

What we offer: 

We offer a competitive salary, a vibrant and collaborative culture and ample opportunities for professional growth. You'll be part of a global network of talent, working on projects that truly make an impact. 

Our compensation: 

- A gross annual salary range of 80,000€ - 95,000€, based on experience level.

- Hybrid working flexibility.

- Access to learning platforms .

- Wellbeing initiatives including mental health support programs and wellness activities. 

- Employee discounts and access to WPP/VML global benefits ecosystem. 

- Participation in team events, agency gatherings and cross-discipline workshops. 

- At WPP ES, we believe in investing in people who build long-term value for our clients and their customers. Your growth is part of our growth. 

About WPP 

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence and world-class partnerships – all united by our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. For more information, visit WPP.com .

We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers.

title: Senior Data Scientist
description:
Wil je als Data Scientist niet alleen een goed model ontwikkelen, maar ook zien wat er in de praktijk mee gebeurt?

Bij adesso werk je aan Data & AI-vraagstukken waarbij je betrokken blijft van de eerste vraag tot de uiteindelijke toepassing. Je onderzoekt samen met de klant wat er nodig is, ontwikkelt en verbetert modellen en werkt met collega’s aan oplossingen die daadwerkelijk in gebruik worden genomen.

Als Senior Data Scientist krijg je daarnaast de ruimte om inhoudelijk richting te geven. Aan projecten, aan collega’s én aan de verdere ontwikkeling van ons Data & AI-team.

Wat maakt deze rol interessant?

Ons Data & AI-team in Nederland groeit. Daardoor stap je niet in een omgeving waarin alles al jarenlang vastligt. Je krijgt juist de ruimte om mee te denken over hoe we werken, welke expertise we verder ontwikkelen en welke oplossingen we als team naar klanten brengen.

Je kunt je binnen projecten inhoudelijk verdiepen, maar hoeft je niet te beperken tot alleen het bouwen van modellen. Als je het leuk vindt om klanten te adviseren, collega’s te begeleiden of mee te bouwen aan nieuwe proposities, dan is daar ruimte voor.

Ook werk je samen met ervaren Data Engineers, AI-specialisten, consultants en architecten. En doordat adesso onderdeel is van een internationale organisatie met meer dan 11.000 collega’s in Europa, kun je ook expertise buiten Nederland benutten.

Je krijgt dus niet alleen een volgende Data Science-opdracht, maar de mogelijkheid om invloed te hebben op hoe we Data & AI binnen adesso verder ontwikkelen.

Data Science die echt wordt gebruikt

De projecten waaraan we werken verschillen behoorlijk.

Een voorbeeld is een Data Science-team binnen de fitnessbranche dat wordt geleid door een collega van adesso. Daar wordt met Computer Vision en Machine Learning gewerkt aan het automatisch herkennen van afwijkende en mogelijk gevaarlijke situaties in onbemande 24/7-locaties.

Denk aan een geweldsincident, iemand die onwel wordt of iemand die ongeoorloofd toegang probeert te krijgen. Door dit soort situaties sneller te herkennen, kan er eerder worden gereageerd.

Het laat goed zien waar we binnen Data & AI naartoe willen: niet alleen experimenteren met technologie, maar oplossingen ontwikkelen die in de praktijk worden ingezet en daar daadwerkelijk iets toevoegen.

Wat ga je doen?

Als Senior Data Scientist werk je aan verschillende klantvraagstukken. Soms begint dat met het onderzoeken of Machine Learning überhaupt de juiste oplossing is. In een ander project stap je in wanneer een model verder ontwikkeld of naar productie gebracht moet worden. Ook toepassingen rondom generatieve AI spelen steeds vaker een rol.

Je werkt daarbij nauw samen met klanten en met collega’s uit verschillende disciplines.

In de praktijk houd je je onder andere bezig met:

- begeleiden van Data Science- en AI-trajecten van vraagstuk tot implementatie;

- technische keuzes begrijpelijk maken voor zowel technische als niet-technische stakeholders;

- begeleiden van junior en medior Data Scientists;

- delen van kennis binnen het team;

- meedenken over nieuwe oplossingen, standaarden en proposities binnen Data & AI.

Je krijgt veel zelfstandigheid in je werk. We verwachten niet dat je alles zelf doet, maar wel dat je verantwoordelijkheid neemt voor je projecten en makkelijk de samenwerking zoekt wanneer dat nodig is.

Wat neem je mee?

Voor ons hoeft een Senior Data Scientist niet ieder platform, framework of product al gebruikt te hebben. We zoeken vooral iemand met een stevige basis die begrijpt hoe je van een Data Science-vraagstuk tot een werkende oplossing komt.

We denken aan iemand met minimaal vijf jaar relevante ervaring als Data Scientist of in een vergelijkbare rol.

Daarnaast helpt het als je:

- een sterke basis hebt in Machine Learning, statistiek en modelontwikkeling;

- ruime ervaring hebt met Python;

- eerder modellen of Data Science-oplossingen van experiment richting productie hebt gebracht;

- hebt gewerkt met een cloudomgeving zoals Azure, AWS of GCP;

- bekend bent met MLOps en software development-principes zoals Git, CI/CD, containers en dependency management;

- praktische ervaring hebt met generatieve AI en Large Language Models;

- makkelijk schakelt tussen techniek en de vraag van een klant;

- complexe onderwerpen helder kunt uitleggen;

- hbo+/wo werk- en denkniveau hebt, bijvoorbeeld vanuit Data Science, Informatica, Wiskunde, Statistiek of een vergelijkbare richting.

Heb je daarnaast ervaring met bijvoorbeeld PyTorch, TensorFlow, Databricks, Snowflake of dbt, dan komt dat goed van pas. We vinden het belangrijker dat je begrijpt wanneer en waarom je bepaalde technologie inzet dan dat je ieder platform al beheerst.

Werken bij adesso

We werken graag praktisch. Niet eindeloos praten over wat mogelijk zou kunnen zijn, maar samen kijken wat een klant echt nodig heeft en hoe we dat goed kunnen realiseren.

Daarbij vinden we het belangrijk dat je jezelf kunt blijven ontwikkelen. In de richting die bij jou past. Dat kan technisch zijn, maar bijvoorbeeld ook richting architectuur, consultancy, inhoudelijk leiderschap of het verder ontwikkelen van onze Data & AI-propositie.

Onze Culture Code bestaat uit ONEadesso, hands-on, straightforward en open-minded. In de dagelijkse praktijk betekent dat vooral dat we elkaar helpen, duidelijk naar elkaar zijn, openstaan voor andere ideeën en samen verantwoordelijkheid nemen voor het resultaat.

description:
Welcome to Planet. We believe in using space to help life on Earth. 

Planet designs, builds, and operates the largest constellation of imaging satellites in history. This constellation delivers an unprecedented dataset of empirical information via a revolutionary cloud-based platform to authoritative figures in commercial, environmental, and humanitarian sectors. We are both a space company and data company all rolled into one.

Customers and users across the globe use Planet's data to develop new technologies, drive revenue, power research, and solve our world’s toughest obstacles.

As we control every component of hardware design, manufacturing, data processing, and software engineering, our office is a truly inspiring mix of experts from a variety of domains.

We have a people-centric approach toward culture and community and we strive to iterate in a way that puts our team members first and prepares our company for growth. Join Planet and be a part of our mission to change the way people see the world.

Planet is a global company with employees working remotely world wide and joining us from offices in San Francisco, Washington DC, Germany, Austria, Slovenia, and The Netherlands.

About the Role: 

We are looking for a Senior Reliability Engineer with focus on Identity and Access Management (IAM) to join the Corporate Engineering team. As an SRE together with other engineers you will be responsible for the continuous operation, further development and enhancement of Planet’s corporate infrastructure and applications, acting as the technical authority for our enterprise identity ecosystem. 

This is a full-time, hybrid role which will require you to work from our Berlin, Haarlem or Ljubljana office 3 days per week.

Impact You’ll Own: 

- Help to ensure the operation of Planet’s internal IT systems, specifically architecting and maintaining our identity providers (Okta, Auth0, Keycloak).

- Improve existing and create new solutions by engineering automated zero-day Joiner, Mover, and Leaver (JML) workflows directly from our HRIS (e.g., HiBob).

- Scripting & Tooling: Use Python or Go to automate repetitive tasks, build custom provisioning connectors for legacy applications, and enforce identity data minimization.

- Identify and reduce operational toil through automation, making our systems self-healing and predictable.

- Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Leverage APIs, Terraform, Ansible, or SaltStack to manage configurations as code, moving away from manual UI/CLI changes across our identity platforms.

- Participate in an on-call rotation and drive the continuous improvement of incident response, root cause analysis (RCA), and post-mortem processes for complex authentication failures.

- Collaborate closely with Security and other IT teams to embed reliability, scalability, and security best practices from the ground up, ensuring our identity architecture complies with GDPR and Zero Trust principles.

What You Bring: 

- 6+ years experience in infrastructure development and/or operations, with a dedicated focus on Identity and Access Management.

- Bachelor’s degree in a related field or equivalent professional experience.

- Expertise with a scripting language like Python.

- Track record of working with large web applications or computer clusters and managing complex identity architectures (Okta, Auth0, Keycloak).

- Experience integrating HR Information Systems with identity directories and handling complex edge cases (re-hires, cross-border transfers).

- Solid understanding of Network principles and operations alongside modern identity protocols (OAuth 2.0, OIDC, SAML, SCIM).

- Practical understanding of PKI, certificate lifecycles (S/MIME, X.509), and managing legacy directories like Active Directory.

What Makes You Stand Out: 

- Operational experience in deploying and maintaining databases.

- Experience using Docker, ECS or Linux Containers in a production environment.

- Awareness of best practices about systems security and defensive programming

- Experience with version control e.g. Git.

- Experience in deploying and maintaining virtual machines e.g. KVM, ProxMox.

- Experience in software development using CI/CD processes and tools e.g. Jenkins, GitLab.

- Experience with Access Control systems, e. g. Avigilon, Verkada or dormakaba.

- Experience with Public Key Infrastructure (PKI) and deployment automation, renewal, and revocation of personal S/MIME certificates.

title: SVP, Data Science Lead, CoE - Global Clients
description:
About WPP Media 

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships – all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth. 

WPP Media is WPP's AI-driven media operating unit, bringing together media, data, and partnerships to deliver creative personalisation at scale. Connected through WPP Open and powered by Open Intelligence, clients see exactly where, how, and why their media investment is working.

For more information, visit wppmedia.com .

SVP, Data Science Lead, CoE - Global Clients 

About WPP Media 
WPP Media is WPP’s global media collective. In a world where media is everywhere and in everything, we bring the best platform, AI, Data, People and partners together to create limitless opportunities for growth. For more information, visit www.wppmedia.com 

The UK is the largest market within the WPP Media EMEA region, with over 4,500 people employed within the WPP Media ecosystem. Marquee UK key clients include the likes of Amazon, UK Government, BT, Tesco, Coca Cola, Bayer, Dell, Unilever, M&S, Ford, Nestle, Mazda, Danone and Colgate. We have a bold ambition: to make WPP Media UK the undisputed leader in our industry. We are evolving our business operating model, our ways of working and placing data, technology and AI at the heart of everything we do for our people and our clients.

ONE WPP – Vision '30 
Join us in shaping the future of our industry with Vision '30 – our ambitious strategy to lead in the AI era. We are revolutionizing our business to unlock limitless growth opportunities for our clients and ourselves, built on four core priorities:

- Collaboration: Foster unprecedented levels of data collaboration across WPP and partners through WPP Open, turning every channel into a smarter opportunity.

- Data & Technology: Leverage our AI-powered Open Intelligence solution, connecting vast data to uncover unique insights, deliver predictive performance and superior brand experiences through our globally consistent DPAM process.

- Innovation: Drive true innovation by generating intelligence from trillions of privacy-by-default data points, focusing on the 'why' behind customer behaviour to create unparalleled competitive advantages.

- People: Developing future-ready talent involves evolving our focus from traditional media planning to strategic business outcomes, advanced technology and real-time measurable results, as AI increasingly automates media investment by 2030

We empower ambitious experts to deliver extraordinary work by challenging ordinary thinking. If you are passionate about an AI-driven future, thrive in a collaborative and data-centric environment, and are driven to deliver unparalleled growth, we invite you to be part of our transformative journey.

WPP Media is a single client centric company with a portfolio of go to market brands. Wavemaker, EssenceMediacom, Mindshare and T&P are our agency teams, these house multiple local and global clients. In addition, we have a number of client specific brands built to service specific clients. These include OpenDoor (Amazon), MFG (Google), OpenMind (Nestle), OpenConnect (BT/EE) and Media Futures Group (Google). All of these teams are supported by consistent capabilities, enterprise level tools and systems and our market leading OPEN platform.

Role Summary and Impact 
The Senior Vice President (SVP) is a critical, impactful leader within WPP Media, demanding deep expertise and strong leadership. They will relentlessly optimise and innovate, translating high-level strategy into actionable plans, ensuring operational excellence and robust performance. This role involves leading a large department, executing strategic initiatives whilst tackling complex problems within defined strategic boundaries. Ultimately, their strong performance and impactful decisions directly contribute to critical functional goals, supporting our objectives and competitive advantage.

Role Summary and Impact 

- This role is for Data Science across Global Clients. Provide expert oversight across statistical modelling, econometrics, machine learning, AI, forecasting, optimisation, attribution, propensity modelling and experimentation, ensuring methodologies are robust, explainable, reproducible and appropriate to the business problem.

- Team Leadership, Technical Mentoring & Capability Building: Lead, mentor and develop the Data Science team, with particular emphasis on technical coaching and craft excellence. Create an environment in which data scientists can challenge methods, learn from each other, deepen their technical expertise and progress their careers. Establish and champion best practices for code, model validation, documentation, QA, version control and model governance.

- Data Science Product & Service Portfolio Leadership: Own the technical stewardship and ongoing evolution of the Data Science CoE/Hub portfolio within the Analytics & Data Science Menu of Services. This includes Propensity Modelling, ML driven econometrics, MTA approaches, and other advanced measurement, attribution, forecasting & simulation solutions. Ensure solutions remain differentiated, scalable, operationally sound and connected to client needs.

- Innovation & Solution Development: Partner with the Head of CoE, DTA leaders and adjacent product, data, technology and consulting teams to identify high-value opportunities for new Data Science solutions. Translate emerging techniques in AI, machine learning, econometrics and optimisation into practical, repeatable offerings that can be piloted, proven and scaled across clients.

- Technical Assurance & Delivery Excellence: Provide senior technical review and challenge on complex projects, from problem framing and data requirements through modelling, validation, deployment and interpretation. Establish consistent development and QA standards so that solutions are accurate, transparent, maintainable and fit for scaled client delivery.

- Cross-Functional DTA Partnership: Act as the senior Data Science partner across the wider DTA organisation, helping Data Strategy, Client Analytics, DTA Leads, Client Enablement and technology partners understand where Data Science can create differentiated value. title: Senior Gen AI Software Engineer
description:
Liftoff is a leading AI-powered performance marketing platform for the mobile app economy. Our end-to-end technology stack helps app marketers acquire and retain high-value users, while enabling publishers to maximize revenue across programmatic and direct demand.

Liftoff’s solutions, including Accelerate, Direct, Monetize, Intelligence, and Vungle Exchange, support over 6,600 mobile businesses across 74 countries in sectors such as gaming, social, finance, ecommerce, and entertainment. Founded in 2012 and headquartered in Redwood City, CA, Liftoff has a diverse, global presence.

Join Liftoff as a Senior Gen AI Software Engineer and help shape the future of ad tech. As a key member of our Gen AI team, you’ll design and build AI-powered products for our demand-side business, helping teams turn complex data into better decisions and meaningful customer growth.

You’ll work across the stack, building intelligent systems and data pipelines in Python, alongside the TypeScript and React experiences that bring those capabilities to users. You’ll partner closely with product, engineering, and customer-facing teams to identify high-impact opportunities, move quickly from prototype to production, and continuously improve what you ship.

This is a hands-on role for an engineer who enjoys working at the intersection of AI, product, and software engineering. You’ll help define how Liftoff applies modern AI to real business problems, balancing experimentation with the judgment and engineering discipline needed to build useful, reliable products.

This role is ideal for an engineer who thrives in ambiguity, enjoys experimenting with new technology, and is motivated by turning promising AI capabilities into products that create real value. You’ll tackle complex problems, validate new approaches, and drive meaningful improvements across Liftoff.

WHAT YOU'LL DO 

- Own generative AI product capabilities end to end, from understanding user workflows and prototyping an approach through implementation, rollout, measurement, and ongoing improvement.

- Rapidly prototype and validate AI solutions, using focused experiments to test user value and technical feasibility, then turn what works into production-ready capabilities.

- Build agentic workflows that can reason over campaign, customer, creative, and performance data, use well-defined tools, produce structured results, and hand control back to a person when appropriate.

- Partner closely with decision makers and subject matter experts to understand their workflows, constraints, and business context, then integrate AI agents into daily work in practical and useful ways.

- Design how AI systems access and use relevant information, including the data, tools, and instructions needed to produce useful grounded results.

- Build the systems that make AI workflows reliable in production, including tool use, state management, failure recovery, and appropriate boundaries for human review.

- Define clear, testable interfaces between models and software so uncertain model behavior can be handled safely within dependable product systems.

- Develop evaluation systems that measure whether AI features accomplish the intended task, using realistic examples and an appropriate combination of automated checks and human judgment.

- Build the instrumentation needed to understand quality, adoption, business impact, latency, cost, and failure modes in production.

- Apply appropriate safeguards for customer data, system access, and high-impact workflows.

- Build the Python services and TypeScript and React interfaces that turn these capabilities into cohesive products for customer facing teams.

- Evaluate new models and techniques pragmatically, adopting them when they materially improve product quality, capability, speed, or cost.

- Mentor other engineers and help establish shared practices for designing, testing, and operating AI-powered products.

- You have shipped LLM-powered or AI-assisted products beyond a demo and understand the practical challenges of reliability, context, tool use, provider changes, latency, cost, and changing model behavior.

- You understand how to build the broader system around a model, including its data, tools, instructions, permissions, feedback loops, and measures of quality.

- You can define success criteria, investigate failures, and use testing, feedback, and production signals to improve AI experiences over time.

- You exercise strong product and engineering judgment, choosing when a problem calls for traditional software, an LLM-powered approach, or a thoughtful combination of both.

- You communicate complex technical ideas clearly and collaborate effectively with domain experts and non-technical partners.

- You are comfortable working through ambiguity, making informed decisions with incomplete information, and changing direction when evidence shows a better path.

- You are a lifelong learner with strong but flexible opinions, and you thrive on giving and receiving constructive feedback.

Helpful, but not required

- Experience as an early engineer, startup founder, or in a similarly high-ownership environment where you moved quickly from ambiguous problems to shipped products.

- Experience with advertising technology, campaign optimization, performance marketing, analytics products, or other data-rich B2B software.

title: Data & ML Infrastructure Engineer
description:
We are expanding our team with a Data & ML Infrastructure Engineer who will take ownership of the platform that enables data ingestion, processing, storage, and machine learning workflows across multiple products. Operating at the intersection of data science, software engineering, and cloud infrastructure, you will build the foundations and ensure that our ML systems are scalable, reproducible, and production ready.

In this role, you will design, implement, and continuously improve a cloud-agnostic data and ML platform that supports multiple products and teams. You will be responsible for platform reliability, scalability, and cost-efficiency, while providing data scientists and ML engineers with the tools and infrastructure to efficiently develop, train, validate, and deploy machine learning models. You will serve as a technical bridge between the data science and IT/infrastructure teams, translating requirements into robust and maintainable systems.

This role includes ownership of an existing vendor-delivered platform and its evolution into a fully automated, reproducible, and multi-product ML platform.

Key Responsibilities:

- Design, implement, and maintain the data and ML platform infrastructure, including systems for data ingestion, storage, processing, and training.

- Ensure high availability, reliability, and uptime of the platform, as it is critical to the business value proposition.

- Maintain and evolve vendor-delivered platform components and ensure long-term maintainability and independence.

- Build and maintain data workflows, including tools for dataset versioning, experiment tracking, and model lifecycle management across multiple products.

- Enforce DevOps / MLOps practices, including CI/CD pipelines, Infrastructure-as-Code, and automated workflows.

- Develop cloud-agnostic and containerized solutions that can run across public and private cloud environments within EU constraints.

- Optimize data storage, lifecycle policies, and cost efficiency, including tiered storage and retention strategies.

- Implement and maintain monitoring and alerting systems (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana) for pipelines, infrastructure, and resource usage.

- Ensure data governance, security, and compliance, including access control, audit logging, and anonymization requirements.

- Collaborate closely with data scientists, ML engineers, and IT teams to deliver infrastructure that meets operational needs.

- Manage resource and cost controls, including budgets, approvals, and tracking.

- Contribute to documentation, operational runbooks, and onboarding materials for the platform.

Why Join Us? 

- Join one of Europe’s most promising deep-tech scale-ups.

- Shape the future of a rapidly growing multidisciplinary R&D organization.

- Competitive salary and benefits package.

- Enjoy regular team activities and company events.

- Fresh team lunches provided3 times/ week.

Required Qualifications:

- MSc or equivalent with 5+ years’ industry experience in Computer Science, Data Engineering, Machine Learning, or a related field.

- Strong experience with data platforms, cloud infrastructure, and distributed systems (AWS, GCP, Azure).

- Proven experience with Infrastructure-as-Code (e.g., Terraform) and automated deployments.

- Experience with ML platforms and tools (MLflow, Feast, DVC, DataHub or equivalent).

- Experience with AWS Sagemaker or Google Vertex AI platforms.

- Experience with databases (MongoDB, PostgreSQL, InfluxDB or equivalent).

- Experience with message brokers and streaming systems (Kafka, RabbitMQ or equivalent).

- Hands-on experience with containerization (Docker/OCI) and orchestration (Kubernetes or similar).

- Experience with CI/CD systems (e.g., GitLab CI).

- Programming skills in Python.

- Experience with monitoring and observability tools (Prometheus, Grafana).

- Understanding of DevOps and MLOps practices.

- Ability to work across teams and translate requirements into scalable infrastructure solutions.

Nice to Have: 

- Knowledge of data governance, IAM, and security frameworks.

- Experience with cost optimization and resource management in cloud environments.

- Familiarity with multi-tenant or multi-product platform architectures.

- Experience working with EU data compliance constraints in energy, maritime or defense.

Security & Compliance: 

You'll be working with clients in the defense and security sectors, obtaining a Certificate of No Objection issued by the AIVD (Dutch General Intelligence and Security Service) is mandatory. This means you will need to undergo a security screening. For more information, please refer to details on security screening.

title: Software Test Engineer
description:
We are looking for a hands-on Software Test Engineer to ensure the quality and reliability of software solutions used in real-world sensing and data processing systems. 

Optics11 is a deep-tech company developing advanced fiber-optic sensing technologies for challenging environments and applications in energy and underwater security. Our systems enable high-performance sensing and monitoring through advanced photonics, signal processing, and data-driven intelligence.

We are expanding our R&D team with a Software Test Engineer who is passionate about quality, structured validation, and delivering robust software in complex engineering environments. 

As a Software Test Engineer, you will be responsible for defining and executing practical software tests to validate software components (including algorithms, cloud back-end, and user interfaces) that process sensor signals generated by fiber-optic sensing systems. You will work closely with data scientists, signal processing specialists, back-end developers, and software architects to ensure that products meet functional and non-functional requirements.

This role requires a hands-on professional with a proactive mindset, a structured approach to software testing, strong attention to detail, and the ability to understand complex technical systems and translate requirements into effective test strategies.

Key Responsibilities 

- Perform functional, integration, regression, system, and end-to-end testing across edge devices, cloud services, APIs, databases, and graphical user interfaces.

- Define test strategies, test plans, test cases, acceptance criteria, and automated test scripts for an edge and cloud software platforms.

- Identify, document, and track software defects, ensuring clear reproduction steps and proper follow-up.

- Collaborate with product owners, developers and engineers to understand system requirements and ensure test coverage.

- Contribute to the development and maintenance of automated test frameworks and pipelines.

- Test edge–cloud behaviour under interrupted connectivity, delayed or duplicated messages, device restarts, software updates, and synchronization failures.

- Validate software performance, reliability, and stability under different operating conditions.

- Support testing of software running on edge hardware, including hardware–software integration in laboratory and field environments.

- Analyse test results and provide clear, actionable feedback to development teams.

- Ensure traceability between requirements, test cases, and test results.

- Integrate automated tests into GitLab CI/CD pipelines and help define appropriate quality gates.

- Contribute to continuous improvement of testing processes, tools, and quality standards.

- Participate in release readiness reviews and ensure software meets quality benchmarks before deployment.

- Join one of Europe’s most promising deep-tech scale-ups.

- Shape the future of a rapidly growing multidisciplinary R&D organization.

- Competitive salary and benefits package.

- Enjoy regular team activities and company events.

- Fresh team lunches provided 3 times/week.

Requirements:

Technical skills

- Familiarity with test management and bug tracking tools (e.g., Jira, TestRail).

- Programming or scripting skills (e.g., Python, C++, Javascript or similar).

- Experience developing automated tests using tools such as Pytest, Playwright, Cypress, Selenium, or comparable frameworks.

- Experience testing web-based graphical user interfaces.

- Experience testing REST APIs, back-end services, or distributed software components.

- Experience with Docker, AWS, Gitlab , Linux and CI/CD pipelines.

- Ability to design structured, maintainable, and reproducible automated tests.

- Familiarity with behaviour-driven development and Gherkin specifications.

Qualifications:

- A degree in computer science, software engineering, embedded systems, or a related technical discipline or equivalent practical experience.

- Proven experience in software testing or quality assurance.

- Strong understanding of software testing methodologies and lifecycle.

- Experience with both exploratory/manual testing and automated testing.

- Experience testing integrated systems rather than only isolated software components.

- Proactive in identifying risks and gaps in requirements and investigating failures across multiple system components.

- Pragmatic and hands-on when working with hardware, software, test environments, and imperfect real-world data. 

- Able to work independently while collaborating closely with different engineering disciplines. 

- Able to communicate technical problems and quality risks clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Nice to Have: 

- Experience with AWS or another cloud platform.

- Experience testing data-driven or signal-processing systems.

- Knowledge of embedded systems and hardware–software integration. 

- Experience testing unreliable-network, offline, reconnection, synchronization, and recovery scenarios.

- Experience in high-tech, industrial, or defense-related environments.

- Experience with LabVIEW

Security & Compliance:

This means you will need to undergo a security screening. For more information, please refer to details on security screening.

description:
