Tether Evolution : At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways. 

Why Join Us? 

Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If youâre passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you. 

Are you ready to be part of the future? 

About the job 

QV.AC is a general purpose AI assistant that runs locally on your devices. It gives people real control over their data and how they use AI. No cloud dependency, no data harvesting, and no one else's servers between you and your assistant. Our focus is local, on-device, privacy-preserving AI, connected across Tether's peer-to-peer ecosystem. We're building the AI assistant people actually own. Product sets the direction. 

We're looking for a Product Engineering Lead to turn that direction into features people love, built to a standard that holds up on real devices with real constraints. And you have an intuition for AI systems and their limits, so you can turn emerging capabilities into features that work reliably on-device, without needing to build the models yourself.

- Intuition for applied AI and on-device constraints : model size, latency, memory, battery, and the gap between a good demo and a reliable feature. You don't need ML research expertise, because our core abstracts it away. 

- You use AI tools heavily in your own work and enjoy experimenting with new models and capabilities. 

- Deep JavaScript and React . 

- Initiative, curiosity, resilience , and the ability to give and receive direct critique. 

Preferred: 

- Bonus: Experience with local or on-device inference, LLM evals, cross-platform mobile and desktop apps, or open source .

description:
Biobase | Senior Technical Product Engineer, Technical Product Engineer (Early Career) | REMOTE (US, Canada) | Full-time | $150–230k / $90–170k + equity Biobase has grand ambitions. We broker biospecimens, whole slide images, and the clinical metadata attached to them, on a supply-chain backbone that we're steadily automating. We’re building healthcare-data-focused agents on top of the datasets that we’re assembling, too. We'd rather build the thing that removes the work than throw people at it. Two roles, one team, both reporting to the CPO: Senior Technical Product Engineer ($150–230k + meaningful equity).
The product team's technical interface. Architecture decisions and code review on the platform (Python/FastAPI, TypeScript/React, Postgres, Azure); the data pipeline and informatics that take specimen, slide, and clinical data in from suppliers and labs; and product ownership of the internal platform that builds our agents (permissions, evals, cost control, guardrails for sensitive data). You've been the reviewer of record somewhere, you've operated what you shipped, and you think in business problems before tickets. Technical Product Engineer, early career ($90–170k + equity).
Same territory at an earlier stage: the platform, the data pipeline and informatics, and the agents we run against our own operations — with a senior product engineer and our lead engineer reviewing your work and pairing when it helps. Open on background – self-taught, bootcamp, degree, research lab, a career you're leaving – selective on the bar. You've built something and someone else used it. We build with Claude Code every day and expect you to become both fluent with it and skeptical of it. No ticket queue, no spec handed to you. Comp is salary + equity combos you choose between. Full postings: https://biobase.ai/careers To apply: email jobs@biobase.ai with something you built that eliminated manual work and what happened after it shipped. title: Backend Engineer
description:
At Catawiki , every day brings the extraordinary! Whether it’s Daniel Ricciardo’s Formula 1 Car , a Woolly Mammoth’s Skeleton , Lady Gaga's Jumpsuit or Usain Bolt’s running shoe , we encounter exceptional objects every day.

We’re a one-of-a-kind marketplace for buying and selling special objects. Each week, more than 100,000 unique items are auctioned, all carefully curated by our passionate in-house experts.

Having sold over 25 million unique objects, our mission is to become the world’s most popular destination for special objects. As a growing, diverse and sustainable scale-up, we proudly live by three core values. If these values resonate with you, we’d love to explore how you can join us.

- Taking ownership and driving impact 

- Being open to change and feedback

- Being passionate about our mission and our customers. 

Important Notice: While we don't currently have an immediate opening for a Backend Engineer in Portugal, we're proactively building a talent pipeline for future opportunities. If your profile aligns with what we're looking for, we'd love to consider you as new positions become available.

Your Mission 

On our path to becoming the most visited online curated marketplace for special objects, our Engineering team is on a mission to deliver the best experience across our platforms by building best-in-class products for search and discovery, bidding, curation, logistics, payments, and support.

We’re a scale-up tackling customer-facing challenges at high scale, with 75,000 auctions per week and more than 10 million visitors per month. As a Backend Engineer , you’ll support one of our three verticals - Demand , Supply , or Fulfilment - improving and delivering product innovations for our platform.
Working in a small, fully autonomous, and highly collaborative Agile team, you will build scalable, maintainable, and resilient microservices and features. That’s why we’re looking for developers who share ideas, explore options, and communicate openly.

What You'll Do 

You’ll be part of a team with end-to-end responsibility for its own microservices, collaborating across disciplines to build, operate, and continuously improve our products.

- Build end-to-end by designing, developing, testing, deploying, maintaining, and improving scalable microservices and features.

- Own what you deliver , taking responsibility for the quality, resilience, and maintainability of your team’s services throughout their lifecycle.

- Collaborate across disciplines while closely working with product designers, product owners, and frontend, backend, and mobile engineers to share ideas and deliver product innovations.

- Improve how we work , identifying opportunities to make our engineering processes more effective and efficient.

- Strengthen our engineering culture by documenting and advocating for development best practices across the team.

- Raise product quality by fixing bugs and refactoring the codebase where necessary to keep our products reliable and maintainable.

- Learn and experiment by testing new technologies and participating in Technical Week - a week dedicated to creativity, innovation, and knowledge sharing across domains after every two product sprints.

What You'll Bring 

You understand the full lifecycle of web development, identify opportunities, explore solutions, and keep customer needs at the center of your work. Our stack is mainly focused on Ruby; however, prior Ruby experience is not essential if you’re passionate about learning new things.

- Strong software engineering foundations: 7+ years of software development experience, specifically with object-oriented programming.

- Relevant product experience: 3+ years of experience working with customer-facing products in industries such as e-commerce, fintech, or SaaS.

- Backend service expertise: Experience designing, implementing, and deploying backend services with a focus on high availability, low latency, and consistency.

- API and data knowledge: A good understanding of API design, SQL, and relational databases.

- Clear communication: Excellent English communication skills and comfort raising concerns, sharing ideas, and documenting your work.

- Collaborative mindset: You contribute to the team, take initiative, and step in to help when needed.

- Solution-oriented thinking: You actively identify opportunities and explore alternative approaches to solving problems.

- Commitment to growth: You take ownership of developing your skills by learning new technologies and seeking new opportunities.

How We Work 

Our engineers work in small, fully autonomous, and highly collaborative Agile teams aligned with one of three verticals: Demand, Supply, or Fulfilment.

- Teams are responsible for their own microservices from design and development through deployment, maintenance, and improvement.

- Engineers collaborate closely with product designers, product owners, and frontend, backend, and mobile colleagues.

- We value bold thinking, curiosity, openness, initiative, and a strong customer focus.

- Technical Week creates dedicated space for experimentation, creativity, innovation, and knowledge sharing across domains.

Where You'll Be 

This is a Hybrid role based in Lisbon. You will work from our Lisbon Hub a minimum of 2 days per week. 
At this time, we are only considering candidates who are already based in Portugal . As a result, visa sponsorship and relocation support are not available for this position.

In Return 

You’ll be part of an enthusiastic, highly motivated team of 800+ Catawikians. 

- A competitive Annual Gross Base Salary depending on your level, competencies, and overall experience.

- Meal Allowance Card stipend per working day, in addition to salary.

- Health Insurance from day 1 (including dental coverage), with access to multiple hospitals and clinics and a vast wellness network.

- A Work From Home Allowance to help with your monthly household bills.

- Commuting between your home and our office is covered by Catawiki.

- Amazing Office right in the centre of Lisbon.

Why You'll Love Working with Us 

- Create a visible impact by working at scale in a global organisation serving millions of customers across 80+ categories. In our flat structure, every role has a broad scope and directly impacts both our customers and the business.

- Learn and grow through our Learning & Development initiatives, including clear development plans and mentorship programmes to support your career progression.

- A culture of connection defines us . We’re a passionate, diverse team of 800+ Catawikians representing 60+ nationalities. We foster an inclusive and queer-friendly environment where everyone is encouraged to bring their full self to work.

- Celebrate life’s moments with us. You’ll receive a €100 Catavoucher when you join, a €50 Catavoucher on your birthday, and an extra day off each year to “Pursue Your Passion ” . We also offer additional leave for key work anniversaries and important life events. Benefits may vary by location.

Our Offices and Way of Working 

Our vibrant offices in Amsterdam and Lisbon are designed to inspire collaboration. Most Catawikians operate in a hybrid setup, combining office-based and remote work, with a minimum of two days per week in the office, unless a role is explicitly stated as fully remote or fully office-based.

Interested? 

Apply with an English CV and Cover Letter. By applying, you agree to Catawiki’s Applicant Privacy Policy. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every requirement, we still encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

title: Remote Office Assistant
description:
Coalition Technologies is seeking a reliable, detail-oriented, and highly organized Remote Office Assistant to support administrative, bookkeeping, billing, reporting, data entry, and internal operations tasks. This role is ideal for someone with strong communication skills, discretion, attention to detail, and a willingness to learn and grow within a fast-paced remote work environment.

As an Office Assistant, you will help support daily administrative operations, assist with entry-level bookkeeping, organize client documents, support internal reporting, and help maintain accurate company records. This position offers strong growth potential for the right candidate, including opportunities for advancement within the Accounting team or other departments.

We are looking for talented and diligent candidates who perform well on our skills assessments. Strong skills test performance may be considered even if a candidate does not meet every preferred experience or educational background requirement.

Why Join Coalition Technologies? 

Coalition Technologies is committed to delivering high-quality work for our clients while providing our team with a fun, thriving, innovative, and growth-focused work environment. We offer:

- 100% remote work with a company that has supported remote team members for more than a decade

- Competitive profit-sharing bonus plan, with up to 50% of company profits paid to full-time employees each month

- Competitive Paid Time Off plan that supports work-life balance

- Subsidized gym memberships

- Medical, dental, vision, and life insurance packages for eligible US-based team members

- International Health Insurance Reimbursement Program for eligible international team members

- Device upgrade and learning reimbursement programs

- Career development plans with clearly defined goals and rewards

- Additional job-specific incentives and bonuses

Office Assistant Responsibilities 

As an Office Assistant, your duties will include:

- Answering phones and emails

- Completing entry-level bookkeeping tasks, including recording expenses, organizing receipts, and maintaining transaction records

- Resolving billing issues with clients and internal team members

- Providing account access, usage reports, data analysis, and other ad hoc support for team members

- Supporting quality assurance checks for internal and client-facing reports

- Organizing new client contracts, creating invoices, and processing client payments

- Contributing to internal database maintenance, upkeep, and data entry

- Researching, ordering, and distributing company-wide gifts two to three times per year

- Organizing company events, competitions, and special projects throughout the year

- Facilitating company holiday calendars, time-off calendars, and schedule variation calendars

Required Skills and Qualifications 

The ideal candidate will have:

- Willingness to learn, grow, and collaborate with the team and company as a whole

- Excellent verbal and written communication skills

- High level of discretion, ethics, and trustworthiness

- Strong attention to detail and organizational skills

- Ability to support administrative, bookkeeping, billing, reporting, and data entry tasks

- Innovative thinking and willingness to challenge existing methods when improvement is possible

- Availability to work 40 hours per week, Monday through Friday, 9:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m. Pacific Time

- Reliable remote workspace with a fast computer, quality internet, camera, microphone, and speakers

Preferred Skills 

- The following experience is preferred but not required:

- Intermediate spreadsheet skills

- Experience with bookkeeping or financial record keeping

- Experience with Google Sheets, Microsoft Excel, QuickBooks Online, and Google Workspace

- Experience supporting billing, invoicing, reporting, data entry, or administrative operations

Remote Work Environment 

Coalition Technologies is a fully remote company. Our team works remotely with the support of time tracking software, structured communication, and a company culture designed to help remote team members succeed. We have supported remote team members for more than a decade and welcome qualified applicants from around the world.

Growth Opportunity 

This position offers a strong opportunity for growth. Successful Office Assistants at Coalition Technologies have advanced quickly and earned promotions within the Accounting team and across other departments.

title: PhD Researcher: AI for Semantic Structures, Reasoning Flows & Personalized Content Generation
description:
About the position

You are expected to contribute to the development of internationally visible, foundational research in AI-driven semantic structure extraction, automated reasoning-flow modeling, and adaptive content generation. The research focuses on methods for analyzing and representing deep semantic and pedagogical structures in scientific and educational materials; high-fidelity extraction of conceptual and reasoning blocks; inference-time rationale generation; and adaptive, learner-aware sequencing of content. This includes work on semantic parsing, structured NLP, graph-based neural models, metacognitive prompting, ontology alignment across disciplines, and human-in-the-loop optimization.

In this context, interdisciplinary research is strongly encouraged—particularly collaborations spanning computer science, computational linguistics, cognitive science, and the learning sciences. You will contribute to developing datasets, baseline models, personalized learning engines, reasoning-graph representations, cross-domain mapping algorithms, and RLHF-style feedback loops that improve system interpretability and instructional quality. The successful candidate will also contribute to high-quality publications, release research prototypes, and support demonstrator systems that deliver structured semantic extraction, rationale-aware content generation, and cross-domain transfer of reasoning structures.

Additionally, the successful candidate is expected to support teaching activities in areas such as Machine Learning, Natural Language Processing, AI in Education, Knowledge Representation, and Python-based analytical seminars at the BSc, MSc, and PhD levels. Responsibilities include assisting in course delivery, advising students, supervising Bachelor/Master theses, and engaging in methodological innovation for online, hybrid, and in-person learning environments. The university provides strong support for early-career researchers, including mentorship, administrative assistance, access to computational resources, conference funding, and opportunities to collaborate with other research groups and industrial partners working at the intersection of AI and digital education.

Mandatory requirements

- Master’s or PhD degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Computational Linguistics, or a related field.

- Strong research interest and practical experience in one or more of the following areas:

- semantic parsing and structured representation learning

- knowledge graphs or graph-based reasoning

- transformer models, sequence modeling, or GNNs

- natural language generation and explainability

- educational AI, personalization algorithms, or cognitive modeling

- Evidence of research potential through publications, a strong thesis, or significant projects.

- Experience or interest in innovative teaching and learning approaches.

- Ability to translate theoretical insights into engineered prototypes and systems supporting scientific or educational use cases.

- Responsible, self-motivated, and capable of working independently as well as collaboratively.

- Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

- Intercultural competence and experience in international environments.

- Fluency with co-pilot tools for coding and writing.

- Fluency in English, the language of instruction and communication on campus.

Funding & Appointment Terms

The appointment provides full financial coverage through a dedicated fellowship, comprising:

- Monthly stipend of €1,650

title: Staff Software Engineer - Data
description:
About Dune 

Dune is on a mission to make crypto data accessible. We’re a collaborative multi-chain analytics platform used by thousands of developers, analysts, & investors to understand the on-chain world and the frontiers of finance. We’re a team of ~60 employees, working together across Europe and eastern US timezones ️. We believe in our mission, and in building a powerful, open product that allows individuals and communities to do deep research into important ecosystems like Bitcoin, Ethereum, Solana, and many more. 

We’re backed by some of the world's best investors. In February 2022, we announced our Series B funding round led by Coatue and Union Square Ventures, an important milestone that allowed us to double down on our mission. We’re using the funds to educate, reward and empower a new generation of onchain analysts aka Wizards ‍♀️

If you want to have one of the highest impact jobs on the planet, come join our wonderful team of Galaxy brains.

Learn more about us: 

Dune's Vision 

Values and working at Dune 

About the role 

Data Foundation owns how blockchain data enters Dune, how it is represented and how it’s delivered externally. This is a role that involves thinking about large distributed data systems, recognising traditional scaling patterns and software lifecycle pitfalls, and is ideal for anyone passionate about those topics.

You will be the engineer we hand ambiguous product requirements to, and will be comfortable coming back with a design, a sequence, and a set of tasks the team can pick up as well as building the hardest parts yourself.

In this role you will 

- 
Turn product requirements into technical requirements: model the domain, define the interfaces and the workflows, and navigate trade-offs

- 
Break large problems into work other engineers can own, and sequence it so we ship something useful early

- 
Drive high-impact architectural decisions across the data platform, and own components end to end from design through production

- 
Work across our stack, mainly Go, Kotlin, Rust and Python where they fit, choosing the right tool rather than the familiar one

- 
Design for correctness and performance under real volume: large-scale ingestion, distributed processing, and data lake storage

- 
Raise the bar on design reviews, testing, and how the team breaks work down

- 
Mentor engineers by example, in a fully distributed team

You might be a great fit if 

- 
You are a strong generalist with real computer science fundamentals, and you use them to adapt quickly to new technologies and problem spaces

- 
You reason from first principles: you make assumptions explicit, identify the constraints and invariants that matter, and derive the solution rather than reaching for a familiar pattern.

- 
You use computer science fundamentals as practical tools. You have designed and shipped distributed data systems, making their contracts, state transitions, invariants, and failure modes explicit. You know their fault models and scaling weaknesses

- 
You are comfortable with ambiguity : you will talk to product, to customers, and to the team, then commit to a scope and defend it

- 
You use AI tools well enough that they have changed how you work, you understand their failure modes and dislike ai-slop.

- 
You communicate clearly in writing and get the best out of a distributed team

Not required, but a plus 

- 
Experience with data lakes and formats such as Parquet, Iceberg or Deltalog

- 
Experience at a company where the data is the product

Perks & Benefits 

- 
A competitive salary and equity package . Both salary and equity is top 25% of companies in the space

- 
Our employee equity scheme has world-class employee-friendly terms with a heavily discounted strike price (~90%) and a 10-year exercise window

- 
5 weeks PTO + local public holidays (that can be swapped to suit you) 

- 
A fully remote-first approach ‍ within a distributed team with flexible working hours; you structure your own day 

- 
Say goodbye to meeting overload! We believe in a healthy mix of async and sync work, so you can focus on what truly matters—no more wasted time on endless meetings!

- 
Good health is important, so we offer private medical insurance, dental & vision as standard 

- 
We believe in paid parental leave to help you celebrate this important milestone, transition to your new life, and bond with your new baby. We offer 16 weeks to primary and 6 weeks to secondary caregivers, fully paid. Plus a 2-week part-time phased return at full pay to help you get used to your new (and slightly more complex!) schedule

- 
Quarterly offsites in various exciting locations as a company or team to connect, work together and have fun (so far in Tuscany Berlin Austria and Athens ).

- 
On top of this each person gets a yearly travel allowance to connect and co-work with someone or a team of people for a few days.

- 
An allowance for your at-home setup, to ensure you are happy, comfortable and productive. If you prefer a local co-working space, we’ll pay for your desk.

- 
Work with some of the best people you’ll ever get to meet!

- 
And of course, you get some awesome Dune swag ! ✌️

What is The Role 

Elastic Security is one of the fastest-growing parts of our business, and our customers (including government and public sector organisations) rely on our Security Solution to modernise their SOC, threat detection, and response capabilities.

You will lead the hands-on delivery of Elastic Security projects (new implementations, migrations, and use-case expansions) from discovery through architecture design and build. Along the way, you'll develop trusted relationships with senior stakeholders and work closely with our Services, Engineering and Sales teams.

Elastic is a remote-first company, but many of the projects you'll deliver might require onsite availability, making the role hybrid in practice, varying by project, with travel of up to 60%.

- Willingness to travel and work onsite with customers (up to 60% of the time), combined with comfort working remotely in a highly distributed team

- Strong proficiency in both English (our company-wide operating language) and the local market language.

Bonus Points 

- Experience with advanced Elasticsearch operations: cluster architecture, shard management, data ingestion, and data tiering at scale

- Experience with detection-as-code: authoring, testing, and versioning detection content managed in Git

- Experience automating deployments and lifecycle management with Python, Terraform, and CI/CD tooling (e.g., GitLab pipelines)

title: Head of Go-to-Market, AI Care Operations
description:
At Sword, we’re building AI to heal billions and unlock humanity’s full potential. In doing so, we’re pioneering AI Care, a fundamentally new approach to healthcare built for medical reasoning, safety, and real-time treatment, not generic technology applied after the fact. As both a clinical-centric frontier AI lab and an applied AI platform, Sword is reimagining how care is delivered at scale, removing traditional barriers like appointments, waiting rooms, and stigma so more people can access the care they need—and ultimately get back to lives lived in full.

Since 2020, Sword has expanded across physical therapy, women’s health, cardiometabolic, and mental health, and is now moving beyond the session to a fully AI-native, 24/7 care program that brings physical activity, therapeutic exercise, psychotherapy, nutrition, and behavior change into one connected experience. More than 700,000 members across three continents have completed over 10 million AI sessions, helping 1,000+ enterprise clients avoid more than $1 billion in unnecessary healthcare costs. Backed by 42 clinical studies, 44+ patents, and more than $500 million raised from leading investors including Khosla Ventures, General Catalyst, and Founders Fund, Sword is defining a new standard for healthcare.

AI Proficiency at Sword

AI fluency is a core expectation at Sword. Every candidate is assessed against our three-level framework — be ready to share real examples of how AI is already part of how you work.

- 
Explorer (Level 1) — Uses AI daily to boost personal productivity

- 
Builder (Level 2) — Creates workflows and tools that elevate the whole team

- 
Integrator (Level 3) — Embeds AI into products and processes at scale

Every hire must demonstrate at least Level 1. The expected level will vary depending on the seniority of the role.

AI Care Operations (previously Sword Intelligence), is Sword's AI care management division. We don't deliver a clinical program to members. We deploy AI Care Managers, trained on more than 14 million real care interactions, to run the operations of providers, payers and national health systems.

It started as an internal problem. On the way to freeing over a million people from pain, Sword hit the same wall every healthcare organization does: we didn't have enough hands to scale the care we needed to provide. Instead of hiring our way out, we built AI to do it, certified it for clinical use, and ran it in our own operations before offering it to anyone else.

Today we sell two families of solutions:

- Triage — a certified Clinical Triage Line that guides every patient to the right care, 24/7, across voice and digital channels.

- Care Orchestration — care navigation, population health campaigns (screenings, vaccinations, medication adherence), surgery prehab and rehab, and readmission prevention.

We've announced a partnership with the Hellenic Ministry of Health to build an AI-powered front door for Greece's 10 million citizens, and we work with other national health systems, health plans and providers across the US and Europe. The US is now our biggest growth opportunity, and this role is central to capturing it.

The role

We are hiring a Head of Go-to-Market for AI Care Operations in the US. The role sits at the intersection of product marketing, competitive intelligence and commercial enablement. It is one of the leadership roles on the AI Care Operations team, reporting to the General Manager.

Here's the opportunity. "AI agents for healthcare" is one of the most crowded categories in the market right now. Voice AI startups, EHR vendors, care management platforms and outsourcers all claim to automate care operations, and to a buyer they can sound alike. Very few of them have certified medical devices, national-scale partnerships, or AI proven on hundreds of thousands of their own members before it was sold to anyone else. We have all three. Your job is to make that difference unmistakable.

You will own three things:

- Make our value impossible to miss. Build the narrative, positioning and competitive differentiation that make it obvious why AI Care Operations is categorically better than AI point solutions, legacy nurse lines and call centers, and the care management platforms buyers already have. That means the core messaging architecture across Triage and Care Orchestration, positioning by buyer (health plan, health system, value-based care, employer, government), battle cards, ROI frameworks, and the demos and proof that move a skeptical COO or VP of Care Management.

- Make sure the commercial team can tell that story. Sword's segment sales teams sell many solutions and can't be experts in all of them. When the health plan team is in front of a Medicare Advantage plan, or the employer team is pitching a front door for a self-insured population, they come to you to scope the workflows, walk the buyer through how the agents actually work, and answer the hard questions on safety, integration and ROI.

- Find, surface and pursue the opportunities. You will canvass the US and international markets systematically for the accounts, RFPs, procurements, contract renewals and budget signals that would otherwise go unnoticed: a health plan rebuilding its care management operation, a health system under readmission penalties, a state agency tendering a nurse line. You'll use AI tooling to do this faster and wider than a traditional GTM team could, then partner with the relevant segment leader to make sure each opportunity is pursued and won.

AI proficiency at Sword

AI fluency is a core expectation at Sword, and every candidate is assessed against our three-level framework: Explorer (uses AI daily for personal productivity), Builder (creates workflows and tools that lift the whole team) and Integrator (embeds AI into products and processes at scale). This role requires Builder at minimum. Come ready with real examples.

What you'll be doing

- Core positioning, messaging house and narrative architecture for AI Care Operations and each of its solutions

- The category story: why AI care management that does the work beats both headcount and AI tools that only assist the people doing it

- Competitive intelligence and battle cards across voice AI and agentic AI vendors, nurse line and call center outsourcers, and care management platforms

- Buyer-facing materials: one-pagers, ROI and capacity calculators, demo scripts and recorded agent calls, case studies, RFP response library, sales decks

- Proof architecture: turning deployments into case studies and outcome metrics (contacts handled, cost per interaction, gap closure, time to care, readmissions) that a CFO will sign off on

- Solution specialist team (direct reports), paired with segment sales reps across health plans, health systems, value-based care, employers and government

- Sales and customer success enablement: training, playbooks, discovery guides, certification on each solution

- Market opportunity mapping and systematic canvassing across US segments, with a lighter watch on international tenders

- Message consistency across Sword's commercial segments and geographies, including where AI Care Operations is sold as part of the broader AI Care platform

- Voice of the market into product: what buyers ask for, where we lose, and what competitors are shipping

We'd love to see

You are currently at, or recently from, a Lead, Head, Director or VP-level GTM or product marketing role where you owned the full stack: launching products, positioning, competitive differentiation, sales enablement and market strategy. You've built things that measurably changed how deals were won.

You can sell something that isn't a product category yet. AI Care Operations is bought by operations leaders, not benefits leaders, and it competes with a budget line (headcount, outsourcing) as much as with other vendors. You know how to make the case that replacing work is different from adding a tool, and you can tell a clean story across several solutions without it sounding like a platform pitch that means nothing.

You think in first principles. Faced with a new buyer, your instinct is to ask what operational problem they actually have, why our agents solve it better than more staff or another vendor, and what evidence would make a skeptical COO believe it. You don't reach for a template.

You are genuinely AI-fluent, not performatively. You've built your own workflows and loops with AI tools for market intelligence, opportunity canvassing and competitive research. You'll also be selling AI, so you need to understand how our agents work well enough to explain their limits honestly.

You write well and think clearly. Your materials are the kind a VP of Care Management reads and thinks "these people have run a care operation."

You are close to the field. You've sat in on deals, heard objections live, and changed your strategy because of what buyers said rather than what you assumed.

Requirements

- 7+ years in product marketing and/or GTM, with clear ownership of positioning and competitive strategy, and current or recent Lead, Head, Director or VP scope

- Demonstrated ownership of all three: product marketing and positioning, GTM strategy, and sales, field or revenue enablement

- Experience selling to operational buyers (COOs, VPs of operations or care management, contact center leaders) rather than only end users or benefits teams

- Evidence of working cross-functionally with sales and customer success, not only corporate marketing, and of building competitive intelligence from scratch rather than inheriting it

- Based in the US

Strong signal backgrounds

- B2B healthcare software and AI companies with strong commercial engines selling to health systems and payers

- Medical device and health technology companies that sell regulated, certified products into providers and payers

- Automation and AI companies whose products replace operational work

- Has positioned an AI or automation product that replaces labor, and built ROI cases a CFO accepted

- Has built competitive displacement narratives that demonstrably changed win rates

- Has used AI tooling to drive market canvassing and opportunity identification at scale

- Experience with multi-solution, multi-segment GTM, including public sector procurement

How success is measured

This is not a quota-carrying role, but it is not a soft one. You'll be held to:

- Qualified pipeline sourced from your canvassing, by segment and pillar

- Competitive win rate, and win rate on deals where a solution specialist was involved

- Bookings influenced across health plans, health systems, value-based care, employers and government

- Sales cycle length from first meeting to signed pilot or contract

- Enablement adoption: how many reps can pitch, demo and handle objections on each pillar without help

This role can sit remotely and the compensation range will be adjusted to accurately reflect the country in which the candidate resides 

*The range below reflects base, variable, and equity for this role. 

This is a starting point, not a ceiling — once someone joins and proves they're outlier talent, we adjust quickly to make sure their compensation matches their impact. 

Job titles may span more than one career level, so actual pay depends on skills, qualifications, experience, location, and market demand, among other factors. The range reflects base salary plus any variable, bonus, or sales incentives, and our estimate of the value of private company stock options where applicable. It's subject to change, and future stock value isn't guaranteed. Sword also offers additional benefits beyond total compensation. 

Total Compensation Range

$145,000 — $330,000 USD 

Country-specific benefits may vary and will be detailed separately. 

Sword Health complies with applicable Federal and State civil rights laws and does not discriminate on the basis of Age, Ancestry, Color, Citizenship, Gender

title: Senior Data Scientist
description:

- Een bewezen trackrecord heeft als Data Scientist heeft; 

- Energie krijgt van het werken in multidisciplinaire projectteams; 

- Zowel goed zelfstandig kan werken maar ook in teams; 

- Een passie heeft voor Data & AI en het vermogen om zakelijke behoeften te vertalen naar impactvolle oplossingen; 

- Analytisch, inventief en praktisch is ingesteld. 

Over het Data & AI team 
Wij helpen onze klanten innoveren en gebruikmaken van de nieuwste data- en AI-technologie. Ons Data & AI-team bestaat uit ruim 40 data-experts, waaronder Data Scientists, Data Engineers en Consultants. Het team groeit snel en heeft de ambitie om verder uit te bouwen tot een van de meest toonaangevende Data & AI-praktijken van Nederland. Die groei komt voort uit ons succes: klanten kiezen steeds vaker voor IG&H vanwege onze combinatie van strategisch inzicht, technische expertise en pragmatische executie. We werken aan projecten die direct bijdragen aan betere besluitvorming, efficiëntere processen en nieuwe businessmodellen. 

Voor professionals die impact willen maken is dit een omgeving waar ondernemerschap, innovatie en persoonlijke ontwikkeling centraal staan. Hier bouw je niet alleen mee aan de toekomst van onze klanten, maar ook aan de verdere groei van het Data & AI-team zelf. 

—————————
Werken bij het Data & AI Team van IG&H Consulting is ongelooflijk divers en leuk tegelijk. Het is een geweldige plek geweest om mijn technische kennis, management consulting vaardigheden en commerciële effectiviteit te ontwikkelen. Het team is jong en ambitieus, met een sterk verlangen om complexe puzzels op te lossen, zich persoonlijk en professioneel te ontwikkelen en samen leuke activiteiten te ondernemen. Al met al is IG&H al meer dan 7 jaar een geweldige plek om te werken! 
Lars van Kempen - Senior Manager Data & AI 

————————

Waarom IG&H? 

IG&H transformeert toonaangevende bedrijven in de gezondheidszorg, retail en financiële sectoren. Own product development end-to-end: Identifying opportunities, shipping and iterating on features across our stack – taking responsibility for both the technical implementation and the product outcome.

Safety is embedded in our DNA, and our proactive approach focuses on user protection, support, and education.

Join us in this exciting journey and help us shape the future of social interactions!

About this role 

As Yubo continues to scale, Machine Learning is becoming a core production layer , powering critical systems across safety, recommendations, and product optimization.

What makes this role unique is both the scale and diversity of our data , and the level of maturity we are aiming to reach .

We process massive volumes of images, text, and real-time user interactions , across millions of users worldwide, creating a wide range of high-impact ML challenges, including:

- Content moderation (image, text, behavior)

- Recommendation systems and user engagement optimization

- Behavioral detection and trust & safety models

- Emerging use cases such as dynamic pricing and growth optimization

At the same time, our current ML stack is still evolving.
Legacy models are not fully integrated into pipelines, lifecycle management remains inconsistent, and our approach can sometimes resemble “develop, deploy, and forget.”

As ML usage expands across the company, this creates increasing complexity and dependency on reliable, well-structured systems .

There is still a huge amount of untapped potential , with many ML use cases yet to be designed, tested, and scaled, but unlocking it requires building a more robust and scalable ML operating model.

We are therefore looking for a Senior ML Engineer to join our Platform Engineering team, reporting directly to Mikael (Head of Platform Engineering).

You will play a key role in delivering ML initiatives across the company, helping turn promising ideas into reliable production systems. You'll work on everything from model development and experimentation to deployment, monitoring, and continuous improvement, while contributing to the evolution of our ML platform and engineering practices

Your responsibilities

ML Systems & Delivery

- Deliver end-to-end ML use cases (recommendation systems, safety algorithms, moderation models, etc.).

- Design, train, evaluate, and deploy ML models where appropriate.

- Balance speed of delivery with robustness and reliability.

ML Lifecycle & Reliability

- Drive improvements across the ML lifecycle (training, deployment, monitoring, iteration).

- Establish KPIs and monitoring standards to track model performance over time.

- Ensure continuous alignment with product and safety objectives.

- Help improve the reliability and observability of production ML systems.

Platform & Standardization

- Contribute to the evolution of our ML platform through tools, workflows, and reusable components.

- Help establish and promote scalable ML engineering practices across teams.

- Contribute to improving self-service ML capabilities where relevant.

Legacy & Advanced Use Cases

- Take ownership of legacy models and realign them with current business needs.

- Improve, retrain, and integrate them into modern pipelines.

- Contribute to best practices around LLM usage in moderation, recommendation, and other product domains.

- Explore and implement advanced ML approaches where relevant.

Cross-functional Collaboration

- Partner with Data Engineering, MLOps, Backend Platform, and Product teams.

- Act as a bridge between ML, platform, and business stakeholders.

- Provide technical leadership on ML initiatives and help improve engineering practices across teams.

- Share knowledge and help raise the overall ML maturity of the organization.

Our technical environment / ML scope

- ML frameworks: PyTorch

- Languages: Python (data stack)

- Core topics: Neural networks, LLMs, data sampling

- Use cases: Recommendation systems, safety algorithms, moderation

- Ecosystem: Data Engineering, MLOps pipelines, Backend Platform

Who you are

- You have 5+ years of experience in ML / Data, including work on large-scale datasets (datasets of hundreds of gigabytes).

- You have strong expertise in modern ML frameworks (TensorFlow or PyTorch or JAX).

- You are highly proficient in Python (data ecosystem).

- You have strong knowledge of neural networks and practical experience with LLM-based systems.

- You understand ML systems end-to-end (data → training → deployment → monitoring).

- You have strong experience in production ML systems, not only research.

- You demonstrate strong product sense and can align models with business needs.

- You are pragmatic and impact-driven, balancing experimentation with delivery.

- You are able to explain complex ML topics clearly (strong pedagogy).

- You operate well under ambiguity and can structure complex problems.

- You are able to drive technical decisions and influence stakeholders through expertise and collaboration.

In your first 6 months, you will

- Deliver an end-to-end ML use case to validate impact and execution.

- Audit and improve lifecycle management of existing ML models.

- Refactor and retrain at least one legacy safety model.

- Build reusable ML components that improve development efficiency across teams.

- Improve monitoring and observability of production ML systems.

- Contribute to the evolution of our ML platform and engineering practices.

- Help move critical ML systems toward more reliable and measurable long-term operation.

The recruitment process 

- Phone screen with a Talent Acquisition Manager

- Interview with Mikael (Platform Engineering Director)

- Technical case study

- Cultural fit assessments

What we offer 

- A highly competitive salary range as well as equity in the company

- A highly flexible remote work policy, 2 days at the office per month, with monthly team events.

- We also cover fees for external professional events and meetups (Android Makers, etc…)

- Great health insurance coverage for both you and your family by Alan, fully paid for by Yubo !

- Numerous benefits for parents: additional parental leave, easy access to nurseries and daycare facilities in France.

Our approach to privacy & safety 

As part of your role, you may handle tools and features involving personal data. We expect all employees to demonstrate strong awareness of privacy and safety issues, and to actively support our Privacy & Safety by Design efforts.

Join Yubo and help shape the future of Social Discovery while enjoying a culture that values flexibility, well-being, and impact.

Here’s how we live our mission every day:

Y ou own the impact: Step up, adapt, and make it matter

U nconventionally Smart: Hack with intent, borrow smart, build better

B e Bold & Resilient: Raise your head, break barriers, keep moving forward

O ne team, one mission: No egos, no passengers, just shared wins

Trust & Flexibility: Our hybrid model calls for only two office days a month; the rest is up to the rhythm that works best for you.

Enjoy Top-notch Benefits

Culture is central at Yubo, hence the numerous benefits:

Cool Workplace : enjoy our amazing Parisian office and our many hybrid work options

Team Activities : participate in get-togethers, events, and team-building activities

Family-Friendly : we support parents with childcare options and family-friendly policies

Wellness Programs : benefit from comprehensive health insurance, wellness programs, sports classes, and mental well-being initiatives

title: Team Lead Software Engineer
description:
We’re Capital on Tap 
Capital on Tap started because small businesses were underserved. Big banks were slow, their products weren't fit for purpose, and small business owners often couldn't access what they needed. We set out to fix that.

Today we're a financial platform - not just a credit card company. We offer a best-in-class business credit card, SME-focused spend management platform, a savings product that hit £1 billion in funds within its first year, and a growing suite of tools and financial products that make running a small business easier. 

1,000+ employees, £20bn in annual card spend, 200,000+ customers, 17,000+ Trustpilot reviews averaging 4.7 stars, and we're profitable. We’ve done a pretty good job so far, but we’re just getting started! 

We opened our first Portuguese office in Porto in autumn 2025, and in less than a year it has grown to a team of 50. Lisbon is the next step. We're opening our first office in the city and looking for engineers to join as founding members of the team, helping shape how we build, hire and work here from day one.

The role starts out fully remote. Once our Lisbon office is open, it will move to a hybrid set-up of two days a week on site.

Salary: €70,000 - 90,000

What You’ll Be Doing 

We're looking for an Engineering Team Lead to lead one of our product engineering teams here at Capital on Tap.

This is a people-first leadership role. You'll be responsible for the growth, wellbeing, and performance of a team of engineers, while staying technically credible enough to shape direction, remove blockers, and raise the bar on quality. You won't be the best coder in the room you'll be the person who makes the whole room better.

If you're an experienced Team Lead Engineer looking to own a team in a scaling fintech, this role is built for you.

What You'll Own

Your team. Hiring, developing, and retaining engineers. Running 1:1s that actually matter. Spotting who's ready to grow and creating the space for them to do it.

Delivery. Partnering with Product and QA to plan and ship reliably not by micromanaging, but by removing obstacles, managing risk, and keeping the team focused on what matters.

Culture. Setting the tone for how the team communicates, gives feedback, and holds itself accountable. Building psychological safety without sacrificing standards.

Technical credibility. You won't be heads-down in the codebase every day, but you'll understand the trade-offs your team is navigating architecture decisions, technical debt, build vs buy and contribute meaningfully to those conversations.

What We're Looking For

Leadership first. You've managed engineers before and have a point of view on what good looks like. You know how to have hard conversations, give developmental feedback, and motivate people.

Technical foundation in .NET. Our backend is C#/.NET Core and you'll need enough depth to earn trust with your engineers, review decisions, and spot risks. You don't need to be across every layer of the stack you need to be honest about what you know and curious about what you don't.

Product mindset. You think about engineering in the context of business outcomes, not just technical correctness. You can push back on scope, advocate for quality, and translate between engineering and non-technical stakeholders.

Comfort with ambiguity. Capital on Tap is growing. Priorities shift. We want someone who creates clarity for their team rather than waiting for it.

Nice to Have

- Experience with Azure cloud development

- Familiarity with React or other frontend frameworks

- Background in financial services or fintech

Diversity & Inclusion 
We welcome, consider and encourage applications from anyone who shares our commitment to inclusivity. Join us in creating a space where authenticity thrives, and everyone can do their best work.

Interview Process 

- First stage: 30 minute intro call with Talent Partner

- Second stage: 60 minute "Tech Chat" & Values Interview with an Engineering Manager & People Partner

- Third stage: 60 minute Code Pairing with our Engineering Team

- Final stage: 60 minute Case Study with Product & Engineering + 60 minute Good to Great Interview with our CTO

Great Work Deserves Great Perks 

Check out our benefits:

Private Healthcare through AdvanceCare
Anniversary Rewards (€280, €570, €860, 4-week fully paid sabbatical)

️ 36 days holiday (inclusive of public holidays with public holidays carried over if they fall on a weekend)
Annual Learning and Wellbeing Budget
6 free therapy sessions per year
Free drinks and snacks in our offices

Other Info
Check out our ‘Top Tips’ for interviewing. 
✔️Keep updated on new job opportunities by following us on Linkedin .
Email careers@capitalontap.com if you have any questions.

Excited to work here? Apply!
If you’d like to progress your career within our fast growing, profitable fintech then click apply and we will aim to get back to you within 3 working days (during busy periods this could take up to 5 working days.)

title: Senior Software Engineer (Agentic Search) – Web Rendering Engineer
description:
About Nebius: 

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.

The Product 

In a rapidly evolving world, trust in AI depends on AI agents being grounded in fresh, verified real-world data. Search is the foundation that makes this possible. We are building an agent-native search platform designed specifically for AI systems rather than human users. Our product provides programmatic, low-latency, and observable search APIs that AI agents use to retrieve, filter, and reason over real-world information at scale.

The Role 

We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer to build the rendering infrastructure behind a novel search engine designed for agentic AI. In this role, you will design systems that transform modern web applications into high quality structured content for search and AI. You will work on browser rendering, JavaScript execution, and large-scale rendering infrastructure capable of processing billions of pages efficiently. Modern websites increasingly rely on client-side rendering, dynamic data loading, and complex application frameworks. Your work will ensure we can reliably render, understand, and extract valuable information while minimising cost and latency. 

In this position, your responsibility will be to: 

- Design and build large-scale rendering systems for modern web applications

- Develop browser-based rendering infrastructure capable of executing complex JavaScript applications reliably

- Research how modern frontend frameworks render and deliver content

- Improve rendering quality, completeness, and performance across diverse websites

- Optimise rendering cost, latency, resource utilisation, and throughput at internet scale

- Translate rendering research into reliable production systems

You may be a good fit if you: 

Have 5+ years of experience as a software engineer working on production backend or infrastructure systems and are an expert in several of the following areas:

- Browser Rendering

- Chromium rendering pipeline — DOM, Layout, Paint, and Compositing

- JavaScript execution inside browsers and rendering lifecycle and page readiness

- Headless browser execution and browser instrumentation

- Chrome DevTools Protocol (CDP)

- Playwright, Puppeteer, Selenium, or similar frameworks Modern Web Applications

- React, Vue, Angular, Svelte, and modern frontend architectures

- Server-side rendering (SSR), client-side rendering (CSR), and streaming rendering

- Single-page applications (SPA) and Progressive Web Apps (PWA)

- Resource loading, lazy loading, and modern JavaScript bundles

Strong candidates may also have experience with: 

- Building and operating high-throughput content processing pipelines at internet scale

- Distributed systems design and performance optimisation

- Open-source contributions or active involvement in the engineering community

- Conference talks or technical publications

We conduct coding interviews as part of the process. 

Benefits & Perks: 

- Competitive compensation

- Career growth and learning opportunities

- Flexibility and ownership

- Collaborative and innovative culture

- Opportunity to work on impactful AI projects

- International environment and talented teams

What's it like to work at Nebius: 

Fast moving - Bold thinking - Constant growth - Meaningful impact - Trust and real ownership - Opportunity to shape the future of AI

- Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams, including product managers, UX designers, and UX researchers.

- Apply innovative problem-solving approaches and validate both your ideas and those of your teammates.

- Define success for your team and the features you help build and ship.

- Perform other duties as assigned.

You Have: 

- Proficiency in Java or Golang

- Experience designing, building and operating highly available, fault-tolerant, low-latency distributed systems serving millions of users 

- Familiarity with algorithms, data structures, and coding best practices.

- Curiosity and a desire to understand how things work, with the ability to get to the root of complex problems.

- Strong communication skills, able to convey technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.

- A supportive mindset, willing to mentor and help colleagues get unstuck.

- Passion for quality, taking pride in building reliable, high-performance software.

- Empathy for users, able to translate customer feedback into effective solutions.

- A growth mindset, viewing bugs, mistakes, and challenges as learning opportunities.

title: Energy Markets - France (CDD)
description:
About Us

At Axle Energy, we’re building the infrastructure that will underpin the decarbonised energy system. Our software moves energy usage to times when electricity is cheap and green, by controlling vehicle charging, heating systems, inverters and home batteries. We control hundreds of thousands of energy assets.

We’re building in a legacy industry and moving gigawatt-hours of electrons in the real world, but we operate at lightning speed, and we’re growing the team to meet customer demand.

We’re proud to be supported by world-leading investors, including Energize Capital and Accel. Read more about what we’re building here .

France is one of the most important flexibility markets in Europe. This role is critical to accelerating Axle’s growth in France.

About the role

Axle has quickly become the leader in our operational markets, and we’re now looking to expand our reach in France.

At the core of our market expansion plans is market analysis. To maximise future revenue, we spend a lot of time understanding the value of flexibility in power markets around the world.

We are looking for a technical individual (data scientist, analyst or engineer) with strong knowledge of the French electricity markets and an instinct for commercial value.

You will become Axle’s internal expert on French power markets: understanding the market rules, modelling the value, and building relationships with system operators and regulators. We’re scrappy about method and rigorous about conclusions.

You will speak fluent French and English. Other European languages will also be an asset.

What you will be doing

- Developing a deep understanding of French energy markets and grid dynamics to understand how trading, compensation, penalties and cash flow work

- Jumping on the phone with grid operators, regulators and market stakeholders to validate hypotheses and make sense of data

- Building and optimising models of wholesale/NEBCO, capacity, balancing, ancillary services and local flexibility markets in France to forecast what different assets can earn

- Sizing the revenue opportunity across markets and products to shape where we expand next

- Building and evaluating different strategies for cycling a battery or load-shifting an EV charger

- Monitoring and shaping energy regulation to accelerate the growth of flexibility.

This is an opportunity to gain unique domain expertise and build the quantitative case for first-of-a-kind projects across the world.

What we think you need to be successful

- Deep quantitative and modelling ability (Python, SQL)

- Exceptional communication and the ability to turn data into actionable commercial insights

- Comfort moving fast and making decisions in an evolving environment

- Deep knowledge of French electricity markets (NEBCO, Mécanisme de Capacité, Mécanisme d’Ajustement, ancillary services…)

- Relationships with regulators, grid operators and other stakeholders (CRE, DGEC, RTE, Enedis, etc.) are a plus

What’s in it for you

This is a 12 month fixed-term contract (CDD). Compensation is highly competitive and dependent on experience.

We operate with a deliberately flat structure and aim to keep pay equitable across the company, with a 1:1 median ratio between founder and team compensation.

Bi-annual retreats to strengthen team connection & shared purpose.

You’ll be based in France. To maximise collaboration, we ask that you spend ~1 week per month working from our London office.

The opportunity to directly shape the future of energy markets and accelerate the transition to a low-carbon world.

We are extremely keen to build a diverse team, and we’re particularly eager to hear from candidates who don't fit the traditional role stereotypes. If you’re motivated by our mission, please do reach out, even if you feel you might not ‘check all the boxes’.

Interview process

- Initial interview

- Take-home exercise

- Final interview (in-person)

- Offer, references, and welcome to the team!

You are expected to conduct and lead internationally competitive research in AI-driven semantic analysis and automated reasoning-flow modeling, with applications to educational materials, scientific documents, and research authoring. Your work will focus on developing advanced methods for semantic structure extraction, conceptual and argumentative flow reconstruction, rationale-aware content generation, metacognitive prompting, and adaptive personalization. Core research contributions will include designing algorithms for concept and structure extraction, building neural/graph hybrid models for pedagogical reasoning, implementing ontology-alignment methods for cross-domain transfer, and creating human-in-the-loop optimization pipelines that incorporate expert feedback—aligning with the multi-year research roadmap (WP1–WP3) .

As a postdoctoral researcher, you will take a leading role in designing experiments, shaping research directions, supervising junior researchers (including PhD students), and contributing to the development of end-to-end demonstrator systems capable of generating structured, rationale-rich, and learner-adaptive content. You will be responsible for coordinating data annotation efforts, overseeing the construction of evaluation frameworks, and driving publication-quality research outputs, including survey papers, methodology papers, and cross-domain transfer studies. Interdisciplinary collaboration is strongly encouraged, especially at the intersection of computer science, computational linguistics, cognitive science, and learning technologies, and you will have opportunities to initiate or co-lead joint projects with internal and external partners.

The postdoctoral researcher will also contribute to teaching in areas such as Machine Learning, NLP, AI for Education, Explainable AI, and Python-based applied seminars, supporting course development and supervising Bachelor’s, Master’s, and PhD theses. - Experience in leading research tasks, mentoring junior researchers, and coordinating multi-stage projects.

- Fluency in Python and modern deep learning frameworks (PyTorch/TensorFlow).

- Intercultural experience and readiness to work in an international research environment.

- Fluency with AI co-pilot assistants for coding and writing.

- Experience in developing research prototypes, evaluation benchmarks, or large-scale datasets.

title: Signal Processing & Data Engineer
description:
Join the battery cell data revolution⚡

Location: Chemnitz (onsite preferred, hybrid possible) · 
Position: Full-time · 
Start: As soon as possible

Who We Are 🌍

Limatica measures what batteries whisper. We turn the tiny voltage noise of battery cells into a quality verdict, far faster than conventional tests, and help cell manufacturers cut scrap.

We are a team of twelve in Chemnitz and Munich, spanning data, ML, HPC, hardware and industrialization. Early adopters across Europe and Asia already use our technology. In 2026 we move from pilots to production lines, and our data grows faster than our team.

What You'll Do 🔧

Our measurement stations produce several hundred GB of high-resolution voltage data per hour. You own the step from raw signal to reliable answer.

• Work with novel cell noise data: Derive features from raw time series that make physical sense that hold up in production

• Build for streaming: Design feature computations that work in streaming mode, at a throughput of up to 10,000 measurements per hour.

• Make throughput a design decision: Build modular, parameterizable nodes for our distributed processing pipeline and help bring them into our Rust-based production environment.

• Ship modules, not scripts: Automate evaluations end to end, from raw data to reports for our engineering team and our customers.

• Own customer projects technically: Assess requirements, communicate interim results and findings, and turn feedback into improvements.

What You Bring 🕵️

• Measurement experience: A degree in electrical engineering (or comparable) and 3+ years with real-world measurement data. Sampling, noise, filtering and artifacts you know from practice, not just lectures.

• Physical intuition: You can explain why a feature makes sense, and you prefer a simple, well-understood method over a model nobody can explain.

• Data at scale: You think in throughput: data formats, intermediate results, distributed and cached processing.

• Clean engineering: Python, Git, tests and CI/CD as a matter of course. No Rust expertise needed, but the will to learn it.

• Customer confidence: Fluent German and English, written and spoken. You explain results clearly to engineers and managers alike.

Why Limatica 🚀

• Real ownership: Your own part of the pipeline and your first customer project within months. As we grow, this role can grow into technical lead.

• Learn what few get to learn: Electrochemistry, Rust in production and data engineering at scale, with real cells and international manufacturers.

• Share the upside: Salary package including virtual stock options.

• Invest in yourself: Additional holiday for personal learning

• Flexibility & wellbeing: Flexible hours, hybrid work, further benefits via Guud Card and free beverages

What it's like here: You get a lot of trust and a lot of room to shape things. We look for people who stay with a problem until it's solved and who enjoy the moments when a customer launch needs the whole team. Those are the moments where people here grow fastest. This role is intentionally a towards-senior position. You will take on increasing responsibility for pipeline modules and customer projects. title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
About the role 

Data science is in a moment of reinvention: AI-generated code and agentic workflows are changing what it means to put analytical work into production. Posit’s mission is to empower people to conduct trustworthy data analysis for themselves, their organizations, and the world at large. Posit Team is the trusted on-premises platform at the center: a place where data scientists and the organizations that rely on them can explore data, deploy applications and agents, expose and consume MCP servers, and do all of it with the visibility, accountability, and reproducibility that serious analytical work demands. 

We are seeking a skilled Senior Software Engineer to join our engineering team. In this role, you will bring a builder’s instinct to a team working at the intersection of data science, infrastructure, and AI. You will help us build new capabilities and features in our product suite, including things we haven’t yet imagined possible, and you will drive those changes forward into our customers’ hands.

About you 

You are an enthusiastic generalist who thrives in the face of ambiguous requirements—an engineer who is just as good at starting things as you are at finishing them. Some qualities we value most:

High agency 

You are driven. When something important feels daunting or underspecified, your first instinct is to prototype to clarify the value you can deliver, rather than wait for someone to give you the answers.

Boldness in learning 

You are genuinely unafraid to tackle unfamiliar subjects. You know that nobody is an expert in everything, and you don't let unfamiliarity be a reason for not trying. You're not afraid to ask questions and make mistakes, because learning new techniques feels like an adventure and we share what we learn as a team. Proficiency in either Go or Typescript as well as in either Python or R, and experience with backend systems, data tooling, and data science frameworks are helpful for this role. Eagerness and boldness to learn is essential. 

User empathy and product sense 

You make judgment calls on behalf of users with minimal up front guidance and are willing to be wrong, because you will learn. Prior domain expertise with data science as a practice may help, but it is not the only way. Regardless, you lead with empathy: you optimize for solving a real customer problem, not for technical purity.

Collaborative curiosity 

You are generous. When you learn something useful, your first instinct is to share it. You teach as readily as you learn, ask questions without ego, admit what you don't know, and lend a hand when someone's stuck.

Interest in AI 

You are interested not just in using AI in your work, but building tools for customers to use AI in their own work. You also are curious, and you question when AI is not the right answer for a particular problem. You lean on your user empathy when building: knowing that some of our customers use and love AI in data science and others don’t or are restricted from using it.

Results-driven 

You are focused on delivering measurable value to customers. You have a strong technical background with a track record of shipping successful products. 

Within one week, you will… 

- Ship code changes that meaningfully improves the experience for our customers.

Within one month, you will… 

- See your changes reflected in our public releases.

- Participate in feature planning and provide feedback.

- Feel comfortable navigating the codebase and understand how things fit together.

Within three months, you will… 

- Plan features and drive their development.

- Have a track record of teaching team members; both from your expertise and things you learn as you build. 

- Have a track record of learning: both from the things you learned and taught us along the way; and from listening to internal users, external users, and how our customers use our products.

Within six months, you will… 

- Point to new features you built that we hadn’t even dreamed were possible.

Posit offers competitive compensation with extensive human-first, people-focused benefits to prioritize your personal and financial well-being. Individual pay decisions are based on a number of factors, including qualifications for the role, experience level, and skillset. This hiring range reflects base salary and assumes that the job will be performed in the United States.

Hiring Range

$141,800—$187,110 USD

Working at Posit:

- We welcome all talented colleagues and are committed to a culture that represents diversity in all its forms .

- We prioritize giving ourselves “focus time” to get deep work done. We minimize meetings and attempt to operate asynchronously.

- We are a learning organization and take mentorship and career growth seriously. We hope to learn from you and we anticipate that you will also deepen your skills, influence, and leadership as a result of working at Posit.

- We operate under a unique sustainable business model : We have over 50% of our engineering dedicated to creating free and open source software. We are profitable and we plan to be around decades from now.

- Posit is a Public Benefit Corporation (PBC) and a Certified B Corporation®, which means our open-source mission is codified into our charter. As a result, our corporate decisions balance the community's interests, customers, employees, and shareholders. Hear more about why we think this matters here .

Notable:

We offer competitive compensation with extensive human-first, people-focused benefits to prioritize your personal and financial well-being. These benefits apply to full-time positions only.

- 100% of medical, dental, and vision insurance premiums are covered for employees and their families! Fertility and gender-affirming healthcare is included in all of our plans.

- Supplemental mental health and wellness benefits are available via Ginger even if you don’t opt in to our insurance plans, including Ginger for teen family members.

- Posit's gender-neutral paid parental leave policy covers all new parents, including foster and adoptive parents.

- All full-time employees are eligible for 401k enrollment starting on day one.

- After six months of employment, Posit provides a substantial yearly match to employee 401K contributions.

- An annual profit-sharing bonus for employees recognizes our team’s contributions to company performance across the year.

- We are a 100% distributed team. You are also welcome to come into our Boston office. 

- We offer a $400 monthly reimbursement for coworking space rental if you prefer to work away from home. 

- Our Lifestyle Savings Account offers an initial deposit of $1800 and then an additional quarterly stipend of $375 to cover the costs of professional development, wellness, financial health, charitable giving, and remote work support.

- We provide a flexible environment with a generous vacation policy that encourages a minimum of four weeks PTO per year plus 15 paid company holidays.

Are you excited about this role but not sure if your experience aligns with every qualification in the job description? That’s okay. We know multiple perspectives are essential for a thriving organization and we'd still love to hear from you!

title: Senior Software Engineer - Distributed Systems (Continuous Profiler)
description:

● Help design, build and contribute to the core services making the profiling product possible, at a scale that is unusual even within Datadog.

● Participate in multi-disciplinary squads, and iterate with customers, to bring ideas all the way from early explorations to impactful product experiences.

● You will be responsible for your code from development to production, and meet ambitious SLO and quality gates.

● You will be working with many internal and external stakeholders, working on various ways to consume the profiling data, such as the UI, agentic tools, internal applications, integrations and partner products.

Who You Are: 

● Experience with Java and/or Go essential.

● Distributed systems engineer with experience building high performance large scale systems.

● Excellent communication skills (English).

● Ability to meaningfully review architectural proposals and guide technical trade-offs in a complex product space.

● Experience working with AI coding agents to produce performant and maintainable results.

● Experience collaborating with distributed teams.

● Working knowledge of statistical methods, such as sampling strategies, bayesian optimization, sensor fusion etc (nice to have).

Datadog values people from all walks of life. We understand not everyone will meet all the above qualifications on day one. That's okay. If you’re passionate about technology and want to grow your skills, we encourage you to apply.

Benefits and Growth:

● Continuous professional development, product training, and career pathing

● Intradepartmental mentor and buddy program for in-house networking

● An inclusive company culture, ability to join our Community Guilds (Datadog employee resource groups)

● Access to Inclusion Talks, our Internal panel discussions

● Free, global mental health benefits for employees and dependents age 6+

● Competitive global benefits

Benefits and Growth listed above may vary based on the country of your employment and the nature of your employment with Datadog.
